blocks.heading: Enjoy perks to customize your groups needs
blocks.text: Whether it's a birthday to anniversary, reunion or other special occasion, our new group program lets you celebrate a special event on your cruise with your choice of incredible perks. Your celebration just got better when cruising together.

blocks.heading: What is a celebration group?
blocks.text: Friends or family traveling together Wedding parties Birthday celebrations Graduation parties Reunions

blocks.heading: Celebrations plus extra perks to choose from
Base fare group pricing
blocks.text: Group pricing with options to upgrade to Princess Plus® or Princess Premier® for added value.

blocks.heading: A dedicated Princess® expert
blocks.text: to plan your group vacation everystep of the way.

blocks.heading: Keep your selected stateroom
blocks.text: Both first and second guests in a stateroom can be changed up to 21 days before you sail.

blocks.heading: Get points
blocks.text: Points you can use for amenities. Early access to reservations.

blocks.heading: Possible amenities
blocks.text: Cocktail parties A bottle of wine per stateroom Onboard spending money Assorted canapés

blocks.heading: Tour conductor (TC) credits
blocks.text: A Tour Conductor is the organizer of a group sailing together. Princess awards one Tour Conductor (TC) credit for every eight staterooms a group books, which can be used on a ninth stateroom. 1 TC = 8 staterooms You can also use points to buy down the TC ratio to be 1:7, 1:6 or 1:5, which means your group could get one Tour Conductor credit for every 7 (1:7), 6 (1:6) or 5 (1:5) staterooms you book

blocks.heading: Two ways to book
blocks.text: To book a group you'll need to get assistance from either a Princess Specialist or your preferred Travel Advisor. They'll take care of all the details to ensure everyone in your group is well taken care of. Contact a Princess Specialist or call your Travel Advisor

blocks.heading: Eligibility
blocks.text: Available for residents of the U.S. or Canada who set up new groups. Minimum of 5 staterooms, maximum of 20 staterooms held for 60 days from group creation. Maximum size for groups is 99 staterooms. Celebration groups may be created on cruises of 3 to 24 days where group space is available.

blocks.heading: How to Book a Group
blocks.text: Princess is committed to responding within three business days of any group inquiry before or after your cruise experience. If you're not satisfied, we'll make it right, or we'll refund the value of that service.

blocks.heading: Dream big for your wedding day
blocks.text: That perfect wedding you've always wanted? You deserve it. And with Princess® Perfect Weddings it's within reach. Just tell us your dream destination, wedding date and ceremony style, and we'll take it from there. We have a world of options — grand ceremonies in The Piazza, outdoor settings with an ocean backdrop — and packages at a value that beats land-based venues.

blocks.text: At this exciting musical experience, a couple invites guests to join them on the floor for an immersive dancing experience.

blocks.text: Amid breathtaking sets and a 13-piece orchestra, join a brilliant soprano backed by talented singers and dancers—for an evening of music that’s truly timeless.

blocks.heading: Encore brings an evening of glamour
blocks.text: Set amid the romantic splendor of a beautiful Montecito garden, pop, opera, and musical theater combine to delight—alongside an onstage orchestra, stunning sets, and elaborate costumes.

blocks.heading: Fantastic Journey takes flight
blocks.text: Combining rock-concert energy with spectacular aerial performances, this visually stunning, multi-faceted stage production features 270-degree 3D-mapped imagery and choreographed drones.

blocks.heading: Magic to Do casts its spell
blocks.text: Embark on an enchanted musical journey from Stephen Schwartz—the award-winning composer of Wicked, Godspell, and Pippin—where you’ll experience some of his greatest songs and some of history’s greatest magical illusions along the way.

blocks.heading: Wicked composer brings his magic to Princess
blocks.text: One of Broadway’s most celebrated talents—Oscar®, Grammy® and Tony® Award winning composer Stephen Schwartz—has partnered with Princess on four exclusive musicals.

blocks.heading: Experience incredible live music
blocks.text: Reggae, pop, and mariachi. Cover bands, torch singers, and string quartets. Whether you’re listening to soothing guitar before dinner or experiencing a lively Irish band in our pub, you can always find our world-class performers sharing their talents.

blocks.heading: Entertainers in The Piazza
blocks.text: The heart of the ship features exciting new performances every day. Enjoy live music, dancing, acrobats and jugglers—even a champagne waterfall. With great shopping, gourmet treats, and favorite bars just steps away, it’s a delight you won’t want to miss.

blocks.heading: Catch movies under the stars®
blocks.text: Ready for the big screen? Take in our giant 300-square foot poolside movie theater with a 69,000-watt sound system. Enjoy feature films, exciting concerts, or even sporting events — including live NFL football games — on the top deck, day or night.

blocks.heading: Get in the game
blocks.text: Whether you want to compete or be part of the audience, you’ll love the fun our game shows offer—from trivia to bingo to TV-inspired quiz games.

blocks.heading: Deal or No Deal
blocks.text: Just like on the popular TV show, pick a briefcase. With contents that could range from just a penny to $1,000, do you make a deal? Audience members can play along to win just as much cash—or even a free cruise.

blocks.heading: The Voice of the Ocean
blocks.text: In this live singing competition you can share your voice or watch talented guests compete for the title and cast your vote—as guests in the audience choose the final winner.

blocks.heading: Experience the magic
blocks.text: Prepare to be astonished by our renowned magicians and illusionists at Spellbound by Magic Castle on select cruises. Their mind-blowing acts will make your jaw drop in disbelief—and have you asking for more.

blocks.heading: The laughs don’t stop
blocks.text: Count on big laughs and bigger fun when you catch stellar sets from acclaimed comedians on select cruises.

blocks.heading: Quality in every bite
blocks.text: Using fresh, local ingredients from the destinations we visit, our chefs and mixologists put quality at the heart of every bite.

blocks.heading: Unforgettable experiences
blocks.text: Our specialty and experiential restaurants and bars immerse you into the craft and care we put behind every dish.

blocks.heading: Freedom to dine how you want
blocks.text: Walk in to enjoy complimentary fine dining in our main dining rooms, make reservations at a specialty restaurant, or grab a casual bite.

blocks.heading: Personalized service
blocks.text: Experience large ship amenities with a small ship feel; our attentive crew have put in countless hours of training to make your experience nothing less than exceptional.

blocks.heading: How does dining work on Princess?
blocks.text: We're glad you asked... here's a breakdown of the dining categories we offer onboard.

blocks.heading: Restaurants with flavors for everyone
blocks.text: From formal dining to casual eats, enjoy a variety of fresh flavors and personalized service. See some of our top-rated restaurants:

blocks.heading: A taste of Italian tradition
blocks.text: Step inside Sabatini’s℠ Italian Trattoria and savor the craftsmanship behind every dish. Using artisanal techniques and fresh, select ingredients, our chefs celebrate the traditions that define true Italian cuisine. Enjoy the journey of flavor—one dish at a time.

blocks.heading: Discover the craft behind The Catch by Rudi
blocks.text: Master Chef and Head of Culinary Arts Rudi Sodamin has created a menu for this specialty dining experience, drawing inspiration from both the land and sea. Enjoy fresh seafood, chilled oysters, grilled fish, pasta, and succulent steaks, all served with exceptional flair.

blocks.heading: A signature steakhouse at sea
blocks.text: Discover premium steakhouse dining at Crown Grill, where carefully aged cuts are prepared to perfection, complemented by a curated selection of gourmet salts and served in a refined, classic steakhouse setting.

blocks.heading: Savor culinary excellence at Chef's Table
blocks.text: An extravagant menu with wine pairings from our executive chef, the Chef’s Table† is a treat for certified foodies and gourmet novices alike.

blocks.heading: Get immersed in 360: An Extraordinary Experience
blocks.text: This seven-course event, designed to elevate all your senses, perfectly balances fine dining and visual entertainment.‡

blocks.heading: Experience the wonder of Spellbound by Magic Castle
blocks.text: Nestled behind a non-descript door, you’ll enjoy feats of magic from magicians, surprises in themed rooms and theatrical cocktails delivered by sleight-of-hand servers.§

blocks.heading: Taste Caymus wines in a night of fine dining
blocks.text: This dinner features a fine dining food menu paired with wines personally selected by Chuck Wagner, owner and winemaker of Caymus Vineyards in Napa Valley.

blocks.heading: Indulge in a balcony breakfast or dinner
blocks.text: Served by our dedicated waitstaff in the comfort of your own balcony, choose a luxurious breakfast or romantic four-course dinner at sea.

blocks.heading: Meet the culinary artists behind the craft
Darren McGrady, The Royal Chef
blocks.text: Personal chef to Queen Elizabeth II, Princess Diana and Prince Harry, plus serving five U.S. presidents, Chef Darren McGrady shares his expertise through Royal Afternoon Tea - a unique storytelling experience with traditional fixings of tea pairings with scones and pastries.

blocks.heading: Rudi Sodamin, Head of Princess Culinary Arts
blocks.text: Chef Rudi Sodamin is an internationally respected food authority and a legend in the culinary world. In addition to being our fleetwide executive chef, he pioneered “The Catch by Rudi,” an exquisite onboard seafood restaurant that brings the simplicity of fresh, sustainable seafood to your table.

blocks.heading: Makoto Okuwa, master of Edomae-style sushi
blocks.text: One of Miami’s most accomplished chefs, Chef Okuwa excels in crafting sushi fresh from Tokyo Bay. He combines his 20+ years of experience in traditional Japanese-style cooking with innovative techniques for an authentic Japanese dining experience at Princess’ very own Makoto Ocean.

blocks.heading: Tony Gemingnani, 13-time World Pizza Champion
blocks.text: Pizza Chef Tony Gemignani created unique pizzas just for Princess, including Alfredo’s Pizzeria and Gigi’s Pizzeria by Alfredo as well as the top deck pizza – further enhancing Princess’ position as offering the best pizza at sea.

blocks.heading: Dario Cecchini, world-renowned butcher
blocks.text: As "the world's most famous butcher," Dario Cecchini brings expertise from a long line of Italian butchers. He believes it's important to bring back the sacredness of food, and brings this carnivore's paradise onboard.

blocks.heading: World class mixology and renowned artist collaborations
blocks.text: Through exclusive partnerships with visionary founders, we bring distinctive spirits and unique stories onboard.

blocks.heading: Poured to perfection. Curated for you.
blocks.text: Introducing POURS, our signature beverage collection featuring renowned founder-led spirits and botanical-rich, zero-proof and nonalcoholic creations enhanced with natural adaptogens. Experience the perfect way to toast to your travels or find a moment of calm. Only on Princess, every glass is poured to enrich your journey and foster unforgettable connections. Now available fleetwide and included

blocks.heading: Effortless cruising starts with Princess Premier® and Princess Plus®
blocks.text: Make the most of your dining experience onboard—from casual bites to specialty restaurants—and enjoy included drinks throughout your cruise. With Princess Premier® or Princess Plus® you can enjoy more of what you love onboard, while saving up to 70% per day, per guest when you book before you sail.*

blocks.heading: Plan your dining before you sail
blocks.text: Make dining reservations with ease through Manage Booking. Explore available dining options and reserve your preferred restaurants and times before your cruise, giving you one less thing to plan once onboard. Set your reservations ahead of time and enjoy a seamless dining experience from the moment you sail.

blocks.heading: OceanNow, your delivery at sea
blocks.text: With OceanNow®, you can have the best food and drinks delivered by using the Princess® app. Guest with the Princess Premier® and Princess Plus® packages can enjoy OceanNow and room service delivery at no charge.

pages.title: Princess Local Partnerships | Community Impact & Initiatives - Princess Cruises
pages.metaDescription: Discover how Princess supports local communities through our Princess Local Partnerships Initiative – driving meaningful change via charity, education and sustainability.

blocks.heading: What are Princess Local Partnerships?
blocks.text: Princess Cruises and our guests are giving back to the communities that already give so much to us. That’s why we created the Princess Local Partnership Program. Through a period of consultation with local communities, local governments and stakeholders, our crew and our guests, we understood what was most important to Aotearoa / New Zealand. Conservation of the ecological environment and Māori cu

blocks.heading: Tauranga Moana (Tauranga)
blocks.text: The art of celestial navigation (using the sun, moon, stars and planets to guide journeys across the ocean) is intrinsic to Māori culture and their seafaring heritage. That’s why we’ve partnered with Te Kura Waka, a celestial navigation school in Aotearoa, dedicated to training future navigators through traditional Pacific wayfinding and waka knowledge under the teachings of Pwo navigator Jack Tha

blocks.heading: Ōtepoti (Dunedin)
blocks.text: Working with the team at Nature’s Wonders, our efforts on the Otago Peninsula has facilitated new structures being built to enable more nesting boxes for the endangered blue eyed penguin as well as the preservation of the last major yellow-eyed penguin colony. blocks.text: Our work with Princess Local Partnerships is designed to encourage the regeneration of the Opua State Forest, and the return of both the Kiwi Bird to the Forest and the Kororā (Little Blue Penguins) along the shoreline of the Waitangi Treaty Grounds. blocks.heading: Sail "The Love Boat" for the most romantic moments at sea
blocks.text: Romantic Cruises

blocks.heading: Romantic Cruise Destinations
blocks.text: Let a getaway get you closer. And come back more in love than ever… when you sail with Princess to the world’s most romantic locales.

blocks.heading: The Caribbean: treasure your time together
blocks.text: Turquoise waters, swaying palms, secluded white-sand beaches: this is bliss. It’s no wonder the Caribbean is our top destination for weddings, honeymooners and couples just craving an escape. With over 30 island ports to choose from, the two of you can sightsee, snorkel, shop… or, yes, just lounge side-by-side. Because sometimes the most romantic thing you can do together is nothing at all. Heat T

links.text: Heat Things Up on a Caribbean Romantic Cruise

blocks.heading: The Mediterranean: timeless places, priceless moments
blocks.text: Where will you write the next chapters of your love story? Swimming Corfu’s sparkling waters; cozied up in a Venetian gondola; people-watching in a Paris café; biking the Tuscan hills; or strolling the streets of Rome? Let the destination experts take you to these enchanting settings. You two can take it from there. When you share the world with the one you love, you create memories to share forev

blocks.heading: Hawaii: Paradise found
blocks.text: It’s just the two of you – discovering a hidden waterfall, strolling a black-sand beach under a scarlet sunset, gazing up at a billion gleaming stars. You’re not dreaming. You’re in Maui or Kauai on a relaxing, romantic Princess vacation. Lose yourselves in the natural wonders of Hawaii and you’ll find the true meaning of Paradise: experiencing the perfect place with that special person. Say Aloha

blocks.heading: Experiences to Share
blocks.text: Revel in your time together – try something new, explore somewhere extraordinary or simply relax and reconnect.

blocks.heading: Entertainment you'll love
blocks.text: See how it takes two to tango in a ballroom dance class. Request the song you call yours from the live band. Test how well you know each other in the Marriage Match Game Show. Get on the Kiss Cam at the Love Boat Disco Deck Party. Learn how to say “I love you” in a different language. Opportunities to bond are everywhere. Learn more about Onboard Entertainment

blocks.heading: A passion for great food
blocks.text: Apologies to Shakespeare, but food is the food of love. Imagine Valentine’s Day without chocolate, or a date without Champagne. Not here. Savor a romantic dinner for two at one of our specialty restaurants or on your private balcony. Sweeten the deal with a chocolate and wine tasting. Play, or rather, eat on! Learn more about Food & Dining

blocks.heading: Romantic escapades
blocks.text: Ride a horse-drawn carriage through Tuscan vineyards. Share a picnic lunch after visiting an active volcano on the Big Island of Hawaii. Surround yourself with beauty in bloom at the Butchart Gardens in Victoria. Rediscover your sense of wonder and why you fell in love in the first place on award-winning excursions. Learn more about Shore Excursions

blocks.heading: Relax on the best cruise for couples
blocks.text: Leave the hustle and bustle behind in the Lotus Spa®, your haven away from home. Indulge in a couples’ massage. Primp for formal night — or just a night out — with any of our special salon services. Make the most of days free of obligation, where the only item on your to-do list is enjoying spending time together. Learn more about Onboard Wellness

blocks.heading: Occasions to Celebrate
blocks.text: Relationship milestones are always worth commemorating, and here you’ll find them treated with the fanfare they deserve.

blocks.heading: An Anniversary to remember
blocks.text: Reflect on the road you’ve traveled together in quiet moments and larger-than-life adventures. It’s easy at sea, when you have the time and space to focus on one another. Anniversaries are the most popular reason our guests sail, so we make sure they get their due, offering packages that add a festive touch. Better yet, renew your vows in a personalized ceremony on board. View Anniversary Package

blocks.heading: Princess® perfect weddings (and more to love)
blocks.text: As The Love Boat®, we're all about romance. Come aboard for a wedding ceremony or vow renewal, performed by your ship’s captain! You can't beat the cost and convenience — we handle every detail for much less than land-based venues — or the views. Explore our wedding packages

blocks.heading: Embarking on adventure together
blocks.text: Pop the question with a Princess® Perfect Proposal package that makes sure it all goes without a hitch (except the one you want). Planning your honeymoon? The sea is the limit with more than 250 itineraries to 330 destinations. See the options for your proposal and your honeymoon as well as other romance packages

blocks.text: Sing “Auld Lang Syne” as balloons drop on a New Year’s sailing that kicks off the new year in style. When every day is like a holiday, special celebrations occur on an even grander scale. Learn more about Holiday Cruise Activities

blocks.heading: Revitalize your body & spirit at Lotus Spa®
blocks.text: Choose from a variety of treatments, including aroma stone therapy massages, detoxifying ocean wraps, and more. No matter how you want to relax, you’ll enjoy attentive service and a soothing atmosphere.†

blocks.heading: Experience tranquil luxury at The Enclave®
blocks.text: Discover a serene oasis at The Enclave®, our relaxation sanctuary aboard the elegant Princess ships. Immerse yourself in the rejuvenating thermal suite, where dry heat, steam, and mist blend with soothing aromatherapy. Unwind on warm stone beds and let life's stresses fade away. The Enclave is ready to welcome you on Regal Princess®, Royal Princess®, Majestic Princess®, Enchanted Princess®, Sky Pr

blocks.text: Savor fresh, flavorful cuisine crafted to nourish and delight. With thoughtfully sourced ingredients and flexible options, dining with Princess is as good-for-you as it gets.

blocks.text: Our state-of-the-art fitness centers offer treadmills and bikes with ocean views, free and machine weights, and an outdoor jogging track—so you can keep moving and stay energized on vacation.†

blocks.text: Enjoy your cruise without taking a vacation from your regular fitness and wellness routine. The classes you love most are now exclusively designed for Princess®, including strength training, cycling, Pilates, yoga, and more.†‡

blocks.text: This adults-only, spa-inspired space will help you find peace poolside. Indulge in the soothing music and our attentive Serenity Steward service as you relax.†§.

So we collaborated with sleep experts to develop our award-winning Princess Luxury Bed—now in every stateroom across our fleet. Named the Best Cruise Ship Bed by Cruise Critic, you’ll enjoy the ultimate night of sleep at sea.

The Medallion® Experience
blocks.text: An overview of the latest passport, customs, health and other essential requirements to help you prepare for your vacation.

blocks.heading: Does the Medallion device replace your cruise card?
blocks.text: Yes - your Medallion device replaces the traditional cruise card entirely. It acts as your: Stateroom key Boarding credential Onboard payment method Identification for crew services This means no more carrying cards or remembering multiple items - everything is connected through your Medallion device.

blocks.heading: What can you do with your Medallion device onboard?
blocks.text: Your Medallion device powers a wide range of onboard experiences, including: Contactless boarding and embarkation for a faster arrival experience Keyless stateroom entry, with doors unlocking automatically as you approach Onboard purchases, including drinks, dining and retail Location-based services, helping crew deliver items directly to you Personalized service, with crew able to recognize prefe

blocks.heading: Can you use the Medallion device for dining, activities and excursions?
blocks.text: Your Medallion device connects to the Princess app, allowing you to: Make and manage dining reservations Book excursions and onboard activities Access your daily itinerary Navigate the ship and find venues Everything is centralized, making it easy to plan and adjust your experience at any time.

blocks.heading: How does the Medallion device work for families and groups?
blocks.text: The Princess Medallion device is designed to make traveling with family and friends easier, more connected and more personalized. Whether you’re cruising with kids or a larger group, the Medallion device helps simplify coordination while giving you more peace of mind throughout your journey.

blocks.heading: How does the Medallion device work for children?
blocks.text: Each guest, including children, receives their own Medallion device, which functions as their onboard ID, stateroom key and access point for services. For families, this means: Children can easily access their stateroom without needing a keycard Crew members can assist them more efficiently when needed Parents can stay connected through the Princess app The Medallion device helps create a safer, m

blocks.heading: Can parents control purchases or permissions for kids?
blocks.text: Yes, parents and guardians can manage onboard spending and permissions for children through their onboard account. You can: Link a child’s Medallion device to a parent or guardian account Monitor onboard purchases Set expectations for how the Medallion device is used during the cruise This gives families greater visibility and control over spending while still allowing kids to participate in onboa

blocks.heading: Can someone access my personal information through my Medallion® device?
blocks.text: No, your Medallion device doesn’t store any personal information, so no need to worry if you lose it. If you lose your Medallion on the ship, contact Guest Services for help locating it or having a new one issued.

blocks.heading: Can I wear my Medallion device in the pool?
blocks.text: Yes, it's waterproof, heat, sand and salt resistant.

blocks.heading: Is there a way to wear my Medallion device other than the lanyard?
blocks.text: Absolutely. You can choose from a variety of accessories, such as sports bands, clips and bracelets. Order them for yourself and your travel party in the photo gallery onboard or in the Princess® app once onboard.

blocks.heading: How can I arrange to have my Medallion shipped to my home?
blocks.text: Medallion Home Delivery is currently available for guests with residential addresses in the United States, Puerto Rico or Canada. When completing online check-in,, tap "Medallion" and complete or conﬁrm your shipping information at least 13 days before your Princess vacation begins.

blocks.heading: Can my Medallion device be shipped to my residence if I live outside the U.S.?
blocks.text: At this time, home shipping is only available for residents of the United States, Canada and Puerto Rico. To ensure a smooth arrival experience, we encourage all guests to complete all online check-in steps before embarkation - Medallion devices will be issued at the port for guests living outside the U.S., Canada and Puerto Rico or if one was not mailed to you.

blocks.heading: I need to pick up my Medallion device at the port. Will that be a problem?
blocks.text: Not at all, and you can still complete online check-in steps to make the embarkation process effortless when you arrive at the terminal. Follow the steps on the Princess® app to complete your travel checklist (without shipping to your home). And when you arrive at the terminal, just show your Boarding Pass on your mobile device and look for the Blue Arrival Lane to enjoy easy, effortless boarding.

blocks.heading: Is a Medallion wearable safe to use if I have a pacemaker, or other medical device?
blocks.text: The Medallion wearable includes RF technology that have been designed and manufactured to meet the radio frequency (RF) requirements set by the Federal Communications Commission of the United States. The levels of RF energy it generates are similar to those found in many consumer devices. Manufacturers of Implantable Pacemaker and Implantable Cardioverter-Defibrillators (ICDs) typically recommend

blocks.heading: How can I get help with my Medallion device on board?
blocks.text: Once on board, guests can visit Guest Services or the Photo Gallery for assistance. They may also call the Guest Services Desk or talk to their Stateroom Steward or any of our friendly crew members.

blocks.heading: What happens if I lose my Medallion wearable?
blocks.text: If a guest notifies the crew of a lost Medallion device, it will be disabled and replaced at no cost. For security of purchase transactions, each Medallion device is associated with a guest profile that contains their onboard security photo. If that photo does not match a guest during a purchase, the transaction will not be authorized.

blocks.heading: Can someone hack the system and get personal info?
blocks.text: The Medallion device contains no personal information but transmits an encrypted guest i.d. to our shipboard systems which exceed all cruise industry security standards and uses a combination of anonymization and encryption to keep stored data secure.

blocks.heading: Is there anything else I need to know about my Medallion wearable?
blocks.text: Be sure to keep it with you at all times. In addition to unlocking a world of unique experiences, it also unlocks your stateroom door, it’s your access to the ship and is used to make purchases on board - amongst many other things.

blocks.heading: What do I need to do within the Princess Cruises® App to get ready for my Princess cruise?
blocks.text: Download the Princess Cruises app to complete the OceanReady® steps before you sail. You'll want to complete the following steps to ensure access to the Green Lane in the terminal for faster check-in with less waiting: Order and Customize your Medallion* Personal Info & Travel Docs MedallionPay™ Passage Contract & Acknowledgements** Security & Profile Photos Emergency Information *Currently availa

blocks.heading: Do I need required travel documents for embarkation if I've completed the online check-in steps?
blocks.text: Yes. You must have your required travel documents (e.g. passport) available when checking in at the terminal.

blocks.heading: Does the Princess Cruises® App work before my cruise?
blocks.text: There are several features that you can enjoy before your cruise such as getting online check-in for expedited boarding and creating your own customized itinerary with Your Calendar in the Planner section, which offers a look at shipboard activities happening on your voyage. Other Medallion® experiences, like OceanNow®, require you to be on board.

blocks.heading: Can I complete online check-in for multiple guests in my booking?
blocks.text: Yes, you can complete online check-in for everyone included in your booking. If you’re managing a family or group reservation, you can switch between guests within the Princess app and complete required steps such as uploading travel documents, adding a photo and setting up payment details for each person. This makes it easy for one person to handle the process for the entire travel party.

blocks.heading: How do I manage online check-in for children or dependents?
blocks.text: Parents or guardians can complete online check-in on behalf of children or dependents included in their booking. You’ll be able to: Upload required documents and photos Link payment methods Ensure all onboarding steps are completed before arrival Managing this in advance helps streamline embarkation and ensures a smoother start to your cruise for the entire family.

blocks.heading: Do I need to pay for MedallionNet® Wi-Fi to download the Princess Cruises app on board?
blocks.text: To expedite the arrival experience, plan activities and add experiences before the journey begins, we encourage all guests to download and keep the Princess Cruises Mobile app updated before embarking. The app may also be downloaded and updated at no cost while onboard our ships and connected to MedallionNet.

blocks.heading: What if I have trouble signing in or connecting to MedallionNet Wi-Fi?
blocks.text: Switch your mobile device to "Airplane Mode" in Settings. Turn on your Wi-Fi, and select "MedallionNet" as your Wi-Fi network. Then open a web browser and the page will launch. Click "get online now".

blocks.heading: Is the app available in multiple languages?
blocks.text: Yes, the Princess Cruises app is currently available in English, Spanish and Japanese.

blocks.heading: What if I have additional questions about the MedallionClass experience?
blocks.text: If you have questions while on board, please see any crewmember, who will be happy to assist you. There will also be how-to videos on the stateroom TVs. If you have any questions prior to your sailing, you can call us at: United States (toll free): 1-800-774-6237 United Kingdom: 0344 3388 663 Australia (toll free): 13 24 88 New Zealand (toll free): 0800 780 717 Australia and New Zealand guests (ca

blocks.heading: Expect the extraordinary as you step aboard
blocks.text: With an atmosphere of comfortable elegance, tantalizing dining options and dazzling entertainment, your stay on board Grand Princess will be anything but ordinary. Relax at The Sanctuary, a tranquil haven reserved for adults, enjoy Movies Under the Stars® poolside or dine on tantalizing cuisine at venues like Crown Grill and more.

blocks.heading: Dining options
blocks.text: Indulge your appetite whenever you wish on board Princess®. Every hour, our chefs are busy baking, grilling and sautéing great-tasting fare from scratch. Princess offers unparalleled inclusive dining options throughout the ship with a wide range of culinary delights to suit any palate, from endless buffet choices to gourmet pizza, frosty treats, decadent desserts and much more.

blocks.heading: Afternoon Tea
blocks.text: Indulge in an elegant spread of freshly made finger sandwiches, delicate cookies, and decadent cakes, served with your choice of fine tea or coffee. Learn more

blocks.heading: Main Dining Room
blocks.text: Our main dining rooms give you the flexibility to choose so you can eat where, when and what you want. Choose from Traiditional, Flexible, or Walk-in dining. There’s a menu to please any palate, created by our executive chefs and international culinary team throughout the fleet. Sail with us and savor every dish, from authentic Italian pastas to exclusive family favorites shared by world-renowned

blocks.heading: Reserve Collection Dining
blocks.text: There’s nothing quite like the Reserve Dining experience. Think private entrance to an exclusive area in the main dining room. Expedited seating and dining on your schedule, no reservations needed. Menu options chosen just for you, including a daily chef’s special. And a dedicated waitstaff to respond to your every request. It’s sure to be your favorite way to dine at sea. Learn more

blocks.heading: International Café
blocks.text: Open 24-hours a day, the International Café located in the Piazza is the place for an ever-changing array of small bite meals, treats and gourmet beverages. Grab a freshly-baked croissant to start your day, snack on pies and quiche or choose from a wide variety of salads and sandwiches at lunchtime, and indulge in decadent deserts in the evening. Coffee and tea fans will love the Lavazza crafted c

blocks.heading: World Fresh Marketplace
blocks.text: Step beyond the traditional cruise buffet and experience a world of flavors. Learn more

blocks.text: Our top-deck pizzeria features a bold new look that sets the stage for tempting toppings and classic favorites. Try a slice of our award-winning signature Neapolitan-style pizza. Go simple and delicious with just cheese, or mix it up with a variety of toppings that change daily.

blocks.heading: Coffee & Cones
blocks.text: Complimentary ice cream cones await you at our top-deck creamery venue. Pick up a chocolate cone, a vanilla, or a combination. Or treat yourself to an ice cream sandwich, with a tempting choice of flavors. Energize with an Espresso, Cappuccino, Latte or Chai Tea. If you want to cool down, opt for a refreshing Frappe.

blocks.heading: OceanNow® Delivery
blocks.text: In the mood for a drink while soaking up the sun? Want your favorite treat while relaxing at the Piazza? Order with OceanNow® from select locations onboard and have them delivered to you by using the Princess® app. Whether you’re in the Piazza, by the pool, or in your stateroom, we’ll find you. Additional charge may apply.

You'll find our specialty restaurants are the perfect place to celebrate any occasion. Additional char

blocks.text: Step inside Sabatini’s℠ Italian Trattoria and savor the craftsmanship behind every dish. Using artisanal techniques and fresh, select ingredients, our chefs celebrate the traditions that define true Italian cuisine. Enjoy the journey of flavor—one dish at a time.

blocks.text: A warm, inviting gastropub experience. Try one of our innovative gourmet creations inspired by pub favorites or devour a savory rib eye burger named “Best Burger at Sea” by Cruise Critic. Offering a unique variety of beer, whiskey and cocktail selections, plus live music, there’s something for everyone at this hip, friendly twist on traditional pub fare. Learn more

blocks.text: Original musicals, dazzling magic shows, feature films, top comedians and nightclubs that get your feet movin’ and groovin’. There’s something happening around every corner; luckily, you have a whole cruise of days and nights to experience it all.

blocks.text: It’s no surprise The Shops are awarded “Best Onboard Shopping” from Porthole magazine year after year. On board, you’ll find a fabulous range of fine merchandise from brands like Swarovski, Chanel, Estée Lauder, Clinique, Lancôme, Calvin Klein, Citizen and Tissot, plus local crafts, keepsakes and souvenirs. Roving street performers, quaint boutiques, a spiral staircase and several glass-walled lifts provide panoramic views. Visit the International Café for gourmet coffees, indulge in authentic gelato, and more.

blocks.heading: Princess Theater

blocks.heading: Pools & hot tubs

And what better way to relax and revitalize after a day exploring the world than a long soak in one of our whirling hot tubs.

It’s sure to be your favorite way to dine at sea! Learn more

Serving the "Best Pizza at Sea" by USA TODAY, you’ll delight in the classic favorites like pepperoni and margherita, as well daily specialty pizzas.

blocks.heading: The Bar & Grill
blocks.text: Follow your nose to the Deck Barbecue where the burgers are flipping and the hot dogs roasting, served with a variety of fixin’s and crisp fries. Veggie burgers, bratwurst and grilled chicken breast are also served and all are sure to hit the spot when you are relaxing out on deck.

blocks.heading: OceanNow® Delivery
blocks.text: In the mood for a drink while soaking up the sun? Want your favorite treat while relaxing at the Piazza? Order with OceanNow® from select locations onboard and have them delivered to you by using the Princess® app. Whether you’re in the Piazza, by the pool, or in your stateroom, we’ll find you. Additional charge may apply.

blocks.heading: Swirls Ice Cream Bar
blocks.text: Ice cream cones and fresh sea air await you at our top-deck creamery. Pick up a chocolate cone, a vanilla, or a combination. Or treat yourself to an ice cream sandwich or a specialty crafted coffee.

blocks.heading: Casual, specialty and culinary experiences
blocks.text: Dining on board a Princess® cruise ship is a joyful celebration and our specialty restaurants always deliver an extraordinary experience. They are among the best at sea – or anywhere. We serve dishes made with the freshest ingredients, and our menus reflect regional flavors from around the world. You'll find our specialty restaurants are the perfect place to celebrate any occasion. Additional char

blocks.heading: A signature steakhouse at sea
blocks.text: Discover premium steakhouse dining at Crown Grill, where carefully aged cuts are prepared to perfection, complemented by a curated selection of gourmet salts and served in a refined, classic steakhouse setting.

blocks.heading: A taste of Italian tradition
blocks.text: Step inside Sabatini’s℠ Italian Trattoria and savor the craftsmanship behind every dish. Using artisanal techniques and fresh, select ingredients, our chefs celebrate the traditions that define true Italian cuisine. Enjoy the journey of flavor—one dish at a time.

blocks.heading: Ultimate Balcony Dining
blocks.text: A luxurious dining experience at sea all served right on the privacy of your own balcony by our dedicated waitstaff. Treat yourself to this unparalleled indulgence and savor food, views, and memories that will never be forgotten. Learn more

blocks.heading: Chef's Table Experience
blocks.text: An extraordinary treat for both gastronomes and gourmet novices. The Chef’s Table is a perfect culinary journey for any special occasion. Indulge in an extravagant multi-course dinner created and hosted by the ship’s executive chef. Perfect for celebrating an anniversary or milestone, or just making your cruise vacation even more amazing. To remember the occasion a photo with the executive chef an

blocks.heading: Crab Shack
blocks.text: The Crab Shack is a unique pop-up dining experience with everything from clam chowder and popcorn shrimp to a steamer pot (crab legs, shrimp, clams!). Look for this lunchtime sensation in the Horizon Court. Learn more

blocks.heading: Activities & Entertainment
blocks.text: Original musicals, dazzling magic shows, feature films, top comedians and nightclubs that get your feet movin’ and groovin’. There’s something happening around every corner; luckily, you have a whole cruise of days and nights to experience it all.

blocks.heading: Fine Arts Gallery
blocks.text: Great art, like the destinations we visit, can be awe-inspiring. Peruse our extensive art gallery, or attend an art history lecture highlighting some of the world’s greatest masters. And don’t miss our exciting Champagne Art Auctions, which give you the chance to view and bid on a wide range of fine art, including pieces by famous artists like Thomas Kinkade, Peter Max, and Michael Godard. There i

blocks.heading: The Piazza
blocks.text: Discover Old World charm as you stroll through our breathtaking Piazza—a hub of activity, inspired by the vibrant squares of Europe. Roving street performers, quaint boutiques, a spiral staircase and several glass-walled lifts provide panoramic views. Visit the International Café for gourmet coffees, or marvel at the wine selection at Vines, voted one of the “Best Wine Bars at Sea,” by USA Today.

blocks.heading: Princess Theater
blocks.text: With dazzling stage sets, artists from around the globe, modern hits and timeless classics, the Princess Theater showcases lavish, original productions with dynamic cast members in sumptuous surroundings. In this ultramodern theater, relax in a plush seat with unobstructed sight lines as the velvet curtain goes up, a state-of-the-art lighting system illuminates the stage, and it’s on with the show

blocks.heading: Vegas Style Casino
blocks.text: From gaming lessons to the latest slot machines to prize tournaments, our Casinos offer fun and excitement. If you enjoy blackjack, or “21,” and Texas Hold 'Em, our tables play by Vegas rules and if you relish the challenge of roulette, we offer the American version.

blocks.heading: Movies Under the Stars®
blocks.text: Throughout the day and night, our exclusive open-air poolside amphitheater is the go-to destination for feature films, thrilling concerts and exciting sporting events such as live football games. Cozy up under a fleece blanket in the comfortable lounger and feast on complimentary fresh-popped popcorn in the evening or delicious cookies and milk during the day, and enjoy that exciting car chase or

blocks.heading: Music & Dancing
blocks.text: When it comes to music and dancing we’ve got everything that your musical palette may desire. Whether it’s tapping your toes to cover bands, singing along in the piano bar, relaxing to classical strings or dancing the night away in the nightclub, you’ll be satisfied!

blocks.heading: Pools & hot tubs
blocks.text: Take a dip in our sparkling pools and leave your everyday world behind. Unwind on a padded lounger and soak up the sun, catch up on reading, listen to music or dream of your next adventure on board or ashore. And what better way to relax and revitalize after a day exploring the world than a long soak in one of our whirling hot tubs.

blocks.heading: Top deck parties
blocks.text: For breathtaking ocean views and engaging opportunities to meet new friends and celebrate your voyage, no place beats the top deck. Under the sun or under the stars, top-deck parties welcome you to enjoy drinks and dancing, accompanied by a live band. And special themes give each party its own distinctive energy.

blocks.heading: Universe Lounge
blocks.text: It’s on with the show in this art deco style intimate theater with dramatic lighting and three revolving stages creating an extraordinarily versatile performance venue. Settle into a comfortable seat and watch an engaging cooking class and demonstration, a trendy fashion show or expand your knowledge at an enrichment lecture series. Cabaret shows and full-scale theatrical productions will make it

blocks.heading: Bars
blocks.text: Whether you're unwinding by the pool or raising a toast before dinner, our bars serve premium wines along with craft cocktails infused with local flavors, offering all the tastes you love.

blocks.heading: Wheelhouse Bar
blocks.text: Stop by the Wheelhouse Bar for pre-dinner drinks or post-performance libations. The menu offers a wide selection of classic cocktails, beers, wines, martinis and exclusive signature drinks. Learn more

blocks.heading: Good Spirits® At Sea
blocks.text: Good Spirits takes viewers around the globe in search of extraordinary everyday people, sharing stories of spirits and collecting farm-fresh, local ingredients to inspire one-of-a-kind cocktail creations. Immerse yourself in the region as skilled bartenders lead you through an immersive cocktail experience. Learn more

blocks.heading: Crooners
blocks.text: Step into Crooners bar and be transported to the classic Sinatra era, made complete with a top notch pianist singing tunes and tickling the ivories. The “Rat Pack” atmosphere and famous menu of signature martinis, and old-school mixed drinks will have you crooning. Learn more

blocks.heading: Staterooms
blocks.text: From the moment you step aboard, we want you to feel welcomed and right at home. And with attentive service from a friendly staff that knows what hospitality means, you’ll find your Princess® ship truly is your home away from home. Photos, floor plan diagrams, amenities, and furnishings represent typical arrangements and may vary by ship and stateroom.

blocks.heading: Wellness
blocks.text: Revitalize and refresh body, mind and soul with Princess®. From rejuvenating spa treatments and the tranquility of a top-deck retreat reserved just for adults to our state-of-the-art fitness centers, you’ll find all the elements for mind & body renewal.

blocks.heading: Kids, Teens & Family
blocks.text: From family-friendly stateroom options to enriching youth and family programs, quality time is time well spent. Onboard activities spark curiosity and fuel creativity while excursions ashore engage and inspire.

blocks.heading: Family
blocks.text: Princess makes it easy to sail together in comfort. There is a wide selection of staterooms accommodating up to four guests, and you’ll enjoy substantial savings on your third and fourth guests. There are also connecting stateroom options, as well as Two Bedroom Family Suites, with room for up to eight guests, which offer more living space, a balcony and two bathrooms, including a full bath tub.

blocks.heading: Just For Kids 3-7
blocks.text: Even the littlest guests will delight in this whimsical, forest-themed world that inspires playtime and invites exploration. Kids, ages 3 to 7, can dance, enjoy pajama movie nights, create art projects like puppets and masks or compete in a Lego® boat-building contest.

blocks.heading: Just For Kids 8-12
blocks.text: Inspired by the great outdoors, this cozy center keeps kids busy with games, dancing and kid-sized Olympic competitions. Their minds stay busy, too, with California Science Center programs like rocket building, or they can explore outer space with Stargazing and learning how to build a model roller coaster. Exciting events like talent shows, theme nights, and treasure hunts encourage new friendshi

blocks.heading: Just For Teens 13-17
blocks.text: This contemporary lounge is "the place" for teens — perfect for hanging out and socializing with late-night movie viewing, hip hop dance classes, video game tournaments and sports competitions like dodgeball and basketball. But that’s just the beginning. They’ll dazzle on the red carpet with our Rock the Boat teens-only party, complete with awards and "mocktails."

blocks.text: In the mood for a drink while soaking up the sun? Want your favorite treat while relaxing at the Piazza? Order with OceanNow® from select locations onboard and have them delivered to you by using the Princess® app. Whether you’re in the Piazza, by the pool, or in your stateroom, we’ll find you. Additional charge may apply.

blocks.heading: The Salty Dog Grill
blocks.text: While you're enjoying the fresh air on the top deck, treat yourself to one of our 100% handmade gourmet burgers, including our Princess Burger or Triple Smoked Burger. Learn more

blocks.heading: Casual, specialty and culinary experiences
blocks.text: Dining on board a Princess® cruise ship is a joyful celebration and our specialty restaurants always deliver an extraordinary experience. They are among the best at sea – or anywhere. We serve dishes made with the freshest ingredients, and our menus reflect regional flavors from around the world. You'll find our specialty restaurants are the perfect place to celebrate any occasion. Additional char

blocks.heading: A signature steakhouse at sea
blocks.text: Discover premium steakhouse dining at Crown Grill, where carefully aged cuts are prepared to perfection, complemented by a curated selection of gourmet salts and served in a refined, classic steakhouse setting.

blocks.heading: A taste of Italian tradition
blocks.text: Step inside Sabatini’s℠ Italian Trattoria and savor the craftsmanship behind every dish. Using artisanal techniques and fresh, select ingredients, our chefs celebrate the traditions that define true Italian cuisine. Enjoy the journey of flavor—one dish at a time.

blocks.heading: O'Malley's Irish Pub
blocks.text: Feel like you’ve stepped into a pub in Dublin at this warm, welcoming spot. It goes beyond the music, drinks and food, though you MUST try to the Dubliner Burger. It’s about the feeling you get when you’re here. It’s a bring-the-whole-gang-to-celebrate-a-birthday-or-watch-the-game kind of place. Rich browns and dark greens infuse the pub, named for a famous Irish pirate queen. Learn more

blocks.heading: Chef's Table Experience
blocks.text: An extraordinary treat for both gastronomes and gourmet novices. The Chef’s Table is a perfect culinary journey for any special occasion. Indulge in an extravagant multi-course dinner created and hosted by the ship’s executive chef. Perfect for celebrating an anniversary or milestone, or just making your cruise vacation even more amazing. To remember the occasion a photo with the executive chef an

blocks.heading: Steamers Seafood
blocks.text: Dig into piles of fresh mussels and clams, indulgent fried seafood platters and more at Steamers Seafood, a unique pop-up dining venue.

blocks.heading: Planks BBQ
blocks.text: Follow the smokehouse aroma to this pop-up experience with all the favorites you love. At Planks BBQ, our signature planks are piled high with heaps of fall-apart-tender meats and tasty sides. Learn more

blocks.heading: Ultimate Balcony Dining
blocks.text: A luxurious dining experience at sea all served right on the privacy of your own balcony by our dedicated waitstaff. Treat yourself to this unparalleled indulgence and savor food, views, and memories that will never be forgotten. Learn more

blocks.heading: Activities & Entertainment
blocks.text: Original musicals, dazzling magic shows, feature films, top comedians and nightclubs that get your feet movin’ and groovin’. There’s something happening around every corner; luckily, you have a whole cruise of days and nights to experience it all.

blocks.heading: The Shops of Princess
blocks.text: It’s no surprise The Shops are awarded “Best Onboard Shopping” from Porthole magazine year after year. On board, you’ll find a fabulous range of fine merchandise from brands like Swarovski, Chanel, Estée Lauder, Clinique, Lancôme, Calvin Klein, Citizen and Tissot, plus local crafts, keepsakes and souvenirs. And everyday tax- and duty-free savings can add up to as much as 30% off suggested U.S. ret

blocks.heading: The Piazza
blocks.text: Discover Old World charm as you stroll through our breathtaking Piazza—a hub of activity, inspired by the vibrant squares of Europe. Roving street performers, quaint boutiques, a spiral staircase and several glass-walled lifts provide panoramic views. Visit the International Café for gourmet coffees, or marvel at the wine selection at Vines, voted one of the “Best Wine Bars at Sea,” by USA Today.”

blocks.heading: Princess Theater
blocks.text: With dazzling stage sets, artists from around the globe, modern hits and timeless classics, the Princess Theater showcases lavish, original productions with dynamic cast members in sumptuous surroundings. In this ultramodern theater, relax in a plush seat with unobstructed sight lines as the velvet curtain goes up, a state-of-the-art lighting system illuminates the stage, and it’s on with the show

blocks.heading: Vegas style casino
blocks.text: From gaming lessons to the latest slot machines to prize tournaments, our Casinos offer fun and excitement. If you enjoy blackjack, or “21,” and Texas Hold 'Em, our tables play by Vegas rules and if you relish the challenge of roulette, we offer the American version.

blocks.heading: Movies Under the Stars®
blocks.text: Throughout the day and night, our exclusive open-air poolside amphitheater is the go-to destination for feature films, thrilling concerts and exciting sporting events such as live football games. Cozy up under a fleece blanket in the comfortable lounger and feast on complimentary fresh-popped popcorn in the evening or delicious cookies and milk during the day, and enjoy that exciting car chase or

blocks.heading: Music & dancing
blocks.text: When it comes to music and dancing we’ve got everything that your musical palette may desire. Whether it’s tapping your toes to cover bands, singing along in the piano bar, relaxing to classical strings or dancing the night away in Piazza, you’ll be satisfied.

blocks.heading: Pools & hot tubs
blocks.text: Take a dip in our sparkling pools and leave your everyday world behind. Unwind on a padded lounger and soak up the sun, catch up on reading, listen to music or dream of your next adventure on board or ashore. And what better way to relax and revitalize after a day exploring the world than a long soak in one of our whirling hot tubs.

blocks.heading: Top deck parties
blocks.text: For breathtaking ocean views and engaging opportunities to meet new friends and celebrate your voyage, no place beats the top deck. Under the sun or under the stars, top-deck parties welcome you to enjoy drinks and dancing, accompanied by a live band. And special themes give each party its own distinctive energy.

blocks.heading: Club Fusion
blocks.text: When the sun goes down and the moon comes up, it’s time to get your feet movin’ and your heart pumpin’ at Club Fusion. A little eclectic and a whole lot of fun, the dance floor lights and booming sound system invite you to get up and show off your moves and grooves. Karaoke contests, live performances and theme-parties are just a few of the nightly events that will have you on your feet.

blocks.heading: Skywalkers Nightclub
blocks.text: Hot music and cool cocktails set to a DJ spinning popular club tunes is the ideal setting for a night of dancing. Gleaming, ultra modern and ultra cool, this hot spot invites a little stargazing while the colorful neon dance floor invites everyone to get up and boogie down. Boasting panoramic views from its vantage point 15 decks above the sea, it’s the perfect place for dancing and socializing.

blocks.heading: Fine Arts Gallery
blocks.text: Great art, like the destinations we visit, can be awe-inspiring. Peruse our extensive art gallery, or attend an art history lecture highlighting some of the world’s greatest masters. And don’t miss our exciting Champagne Art Auctions, which give you the chance to view and bid on a wide range of fine art, including pieces by famous artists like Thomas Kinkade, Peter Max, and Michael Godard. There i

blocks.heading: Bars
blocks.text: Whether you're unwinding by the pool or raising a toast before dinner, our bars serve premium wines along with craft cocktails infused with local flavors, offering all the tastes you love.

blocks.heading: Vines Wine Bar
blocks.text: Voted one of the “Best Wine Bars at Sea,” by USA TODAY and located in a charming corner of the Piazza, Vines boasts an extensive collection of wines, fine Champagne and sparkling wines and regional offerings for purchase. The menu also includes wine flights and a selection of unique wines by the glass. Charges apply. Menu items may vary by ship and are subject to change. Learn more

blocks.heading: Good Spirits® At Sea
blocks.text: Good Spirits takes viewers around the globe in search of extraordinary everyday people, sharing stories of spirits and collecting farm-fresh, local ingredients to inspire one-of-a-kind cocktail creations. Immerse yourself in the region as skilled bartenders lead you through an immersive cocktail experience. Learn more

blocks.heading: Crooners
blocks.text: Step into Crooners bar and be transported to the classic Sinatra era, made complete with a top notch pianist singing tunes and tickling the ivories. The “Rat Pack” atmosphere and famous menu of signature martinis, and old-school mixed drinks will have you crooning. Learn more

blocks.heading: Staterooms
blocks.text: From the moment you step aboard, we want you to feel welcomed and right at home. And with attentive service from a friendly staff that knows what hospitality means, you’ll find your Princess® ship truly is your home away from home.

blocks.heading: Wellness
blocks.text: Revitalize and refresh body, mind and soul with Princess®. From rejuvenating spa treatments and the tranquility of a top-deck retreat reserved just for adults to our state-of-the-art fitness centers, you’ll find all the elements for mind & body renewal.

blocks.heading: Kids, Teens & Family
blocks.text: From family-friendly stateroom options to enriching youth and family programs, quality time is time well spent. Onboard activities spark curiosity and fuel creativity while excursions ashore engage and inspire.

blocks.heading: Family
blocks.text: Princess makes it easy to sail together in comfort. There is a wide selection of staterooms accommodating up to four guests, and you’ll enjoy substantial savings on your third and fourth guests. There are also connecting stateroom options, as well as Two Bedroom Family Suites, with room for up to eight guests, which offer more living space, a balcony and two bathrooms, including a full bath tub.

blocks.heading: Just For Kids 3-7
blocks.text: Even the littlest guests will delight in this whimsical, forest-themed world that inspires playtime and invites exploration. Kids, ages 3 to 7, can dance, enjoy pajama movie nights, create art projects like puppets and masks or compete in a Lego® boat-building contest.

blocks.heading: Just For Kids 8-12
blocks.text: Inspired by the great outdoors, this cozy center keeps kids busy with games, dancing and kid-sized Olympic competitions. Their minds stay busy, too, with California Science Center programs like rocket building, or they can explore outer space with Stargazing and learning how to build a model roller coaster. Exciting events like talent shows, theme nights, and treasure hunts encourage new friendshi

blocks.heading: Just For Teens 13-17
blocks.text: This contemporary lounge is "the place" for teens — perfect for hanging out and socializing with late-night movie viewing, hip hop dance classes, video game tournaments and sports competitions like dodgeball and basketball. But that’s just the beginning. They’ll dazzle on the red carpet with our Rock the Boat teens-only party, complete with awards and "mocktails."

blocks.text: In addition to the hot dogs, hamburgers and chicken sandwiches that passengers love at the Trident Grill, this poolside eatery transforms into a traditional smokehouse-style barbecue each evening, serving up hearty plates of jumbo chicken wings, Route 66 beef chili, Texas-style barbecue brisket, Kansas City Sweet & Smoky Pork Spare Ribs, and North Carolina Pulled Pork. Enjoy delicious southern fla

blocks.text: In the mood for a drink while soaking up the sun? Want your favorite treat while relaxing at the Piazza? Order with OceanNow® from select locations onboard and have them delivered to you by using the Princess® app. Whether you’re in the Piazza, by the pool, or in your stateroom, we’ll find you. Additional charge may apply.

blocks.heading: Swirls Ice Cream Bar
blocks.text: Ice cream cones and fresh sea air await you at our top-deck creamery. Pick up a chocolate cone, a vanilla, or a combination. Or treat yourself to an ice cream sandwich or a specialty crafted coffee.

blocks.text: Dining on board a Princess® cruise ship is a joyful celebration and our specialty restaurants always deliver an extraordinary experience. They are among the best at sea – or anywhere. We serve dishes made with the freshest ingredients, and our menus reflect regional flavors from around the world. You'll find our specialty restaurants are the perfect place to celebrate any occasion. Additional char

blocks.heading: A signature steakhouse at sea
blocks.text: Discover premium steakhouse dining at Crown Grill, where carefully aged cuts are prepared to perfection, complemented by a curated selection of gourmet salts and served in a refined, classic steakhouse setting.

blocks.heading: A taste of Italian tradition
blocks.text: Step inside Sabatini’s℠ Italian Trattoria and savor the craftsmanship behind every dish. Using artisanal techniques and fresh, select ingredients, our chefs celebrate the traditions that define true Italian cuisine. Enjoy the journey of flavor—one dish at a time.

blocks.heading: Ultimate Balcony Dining
blocks.text: A luxurious breakfast experience at sea all served right on the privacy of your own balcony by our dedicated waitstaff. Treat yourself to this unparalleled indulgence and savor food, views, and memories that will never be forgotten. Learn more

blocks.heading: Alfredo’s Pizzeria
blocks.text: Named for our former Master Chef, Alfredo Marzi and voted "Best Pizza at Sea" by USA TODAY, this charming sit-down venue offers an enticing menu of freshly prepared individual-size pizzas along with beer and wines by the glass. The open kitchen design allows you to watch as the chefs create pizza by hand and serve them straight out of the oven. Venues and menu items vary by ship and are subject to

blocks.heading: Chef’s Table Lumiere
blocks.text: An extraordinary treat for both gastronomes and gourmet novices, the Chef’s Table Lumiere is a perfect culinary journey for any special occasion. Indulge in champagne and hors d’oeuvres, followed by an extravagant multi-course dinner created and hosted by the ship’s executive chef. Perfect for celebrating an anniversary or milestone, or just making your cruise vacation even more amazing. Limited c

blocks.heading: Crab Shack

blocks.heading: Caymus Winemaker's Dinner
blocks.text: We’re all about the wine. It’s why our onboard dining room received Wine Spectator’s 2023 Award of Excellence. Why we’ve invited iconic Napa Valley wineries – Silverado Vineyards and Caymus Vineyards – on board for chef-designed, multicourse meals. Why we offer 250+ labels and can always recommend the perfect pairing. If you love wine, you're in the right place. Reserve experiences through the Din

blocks.heading: Gelato
blocks.text: Get a taste of “la dolce vita” at Gelato, our gelateria on board. (Fun fact: gelato isn’t ice cream. While it’s creamy, it has less butter fat and fewer calories.) Choose from a variety of flavors – hazelnut, tiramisu, pistachio and more – which you can enjoy by themselves or in combination. Learn more

blocks.heading: Ocean Terrace seafood bar
blocks.text: The Ocean Terrace seafood bar is ideal for those who love to feast on the bounty from the sea. This stylish bar offers an array of ocean treasures, including sushi and sashimi along with chilled sake, cocktails, and wine by the glass. A la carte pricing makes it easy to pick and choose. Menu items may vary by ship and are subject to change. Learn more

blocks.heading: Activities & Entertainment
blocks.text: Original musicals, dazzling magic shows, feature films, top comedians and nightclubs that get your feet movin’ and groovin’. There’s something happening around every corner; luckily, you have a whole cruise of days and nights to experience it all.

blocks.heading: The Shops of Princess
blocks.text: It’s no surprise The Shops are awarded “Best Onboard Shopping” from Porthole magazine year after year. On board, you’ll find a fabulous range of fine merchandise from brands like Swarovski, Chanel, Estée Lauder, Clinique, Lancôme, Calvin Klein, Citizen and Tissot, plus local crafts, keepsakes and souvenirs. And everyday tax- and duty-free savings can add up to as much as 30% off suggested U.S. ret

blocks.heading: The Piazza
blocks.text: Discover Old World charm as you stroll through our breathtaking Piazza—a hub of activity, inspired by the vibrant squares of Europe. Roving street performers, quaint boutiques, a spiral staircase and several glass-walled lifts provide panoramic views. Visit the International Café for gourmet coffees, or marvel at the wine selection at Vines, voted one of the “Best Wine Bars at Sea,” by USA Today.

blocks.heading: Princess Theater
blocks.text: With dazzling stage sets, artists from around the globe, modern hits and timeless classics, the Princess Theater showcases lavish, original productions with dynamic cast members in sumptuous surroundings. blocks.heading: Vegas style casino
blocks.text: From gaming lessons to the latest slot machines to prize tournaments, our Casinos offer fun and excitement. If you enjoy blackjack, or “21,” and Texas Hold 'Em, our tables play by Vegas rules and if you relish the challenge of roulette, we offer the American version.

blocks.heading: Movies Under the Stars®
blocks.text: Throughout the day and night, our exclusive open-air poolside amphitheater is the go-to destination for feature films, thrilling concerts and exciting sporting events such as live football games. Cozy up under a fleece blanket in the comfortable lounger and feast on complimentary fresh-popped popcorn in the evening or delicious cookies and milk during the day, and enjoy that exciting car chase or

blocks.heading: Music & Dancing
blocks.text: When it comes to music and dancing we’ve got everything that your musical palette may desire. Whether it’s tapping your toes to cover bands, singing along in the piano bar, relaxing to classical strings or dancing the night away in Piazza, you’ll be satisfied.

blocks.heading: Pools & hot tubs
blocks.text: Take a dip in our sparkling pools and leave your everyday world behind. Unwind on a padded lounger and soak up the sun, catch up on reading, listen to music or dream of your next adventure on board or ashore. And what better way to relax and revitalize after a day exploring the world than a long soak in one of our whirling hot tubs.

blocks.heading: Top deck parties
blocks.text: For breathtaking ocean views and engaging opportunities to meet new friends and celebrate your voyage, no place beats the top deck. Under the sun or under the stars, top-deck parties welcome you to enjoy drinks and dancing, accompanied by a live band. And special themes give each party its own distinctive energy.

blocks.heading: Princess Live
blocks.text: By day experience for interactive events and presentations. By night, enjoy stellar entertainment like cabaret acts, comedians, concerts and game shows. There's always something new happening at Princess Live!

blocks.heading: Fine Arts Gallery
blocks.text: Great art, like the destinations we visit, can be awe-inspiring. Peruse our extensive art gallery, or attend an art history lecture highlighting some of the world’s greatest masters. And don’t miss our exciting Champagne Art Auctions, which give you the chance to view and bid on a wide range of fine art, including pieces by famous artists like Thomas Kinkade, Peter Max, and Michael Godard. There i

blocks.heading: Bars
blocks.text: Whether you're unwinding by the pool or raising a toast before dinner, our bars serve premium wines along with craft cocktails infused with local flavors, offering all the tastes you love.

blocks.heading: Vines Wine Bar
blocks.text: Voted one of the “Best Wine Bars at Sea,” by USA TODAY and located in a charming corner of the Piazza, Vines boasts an extensive collection of wines, fine Champagne and sparkling wines and regional offerings for purchase. The menu also includes wine flights and a selection of unique wines by the glass. Charges apply. Menu items may vary by ship and are subject to change. Learn more

blocks.heading: Good Spirits® At Sea
blocks.text: Good Spirits takes viewers around the globe in search of extraordinary everyday people, sharing stories of spirits and collecting farm-fresh, local ingredients to inspire one-of-a-kind cocktail creations. Immerse yourself in the region as skilled bartenders lead you through an immersive cocktail experience. Learn more

blocks.heading: Crooners
blocks.text: Step into Crooners bar and be transported to the classic Sinatra era, made complete with a top notch pianist singing tunes and tickling the ivories. The “Rat Pack” atmosphere and famous menu of signature martinis, and old-school mixed drinks will have you crooning. Learn more

blocks.heading: Bellini's
blocks.text: Take in views of the Piazza as you sip a Bellini-inspired specialty cocktail, Champagne, sparkling wine or other fizzy beverage. This stylish bar boasts an Italian flair and a prime location. Perfect for a pre- or post-dinner drink. Learn more

blocks.heading: Wheelhouse Bar
blocks.text: Stop by the Wheelhouse Bar for pre-dinner drinks or post-performance libations. The menu offers a wide selection of classic cocktails, beers, wines, martinis and exclusive signature drinks. Learn more

blocks.heading: Staterooms
blocks.text: From the moment you step aboard, we want you to feel welcomed and right at home. And with attentive service from a friendly staff that knows what hospitality means, you’ll find your Princess® ship truly is your home away from home.

blocks.heading: Wellness
blocks.text: Revitalize and refresh body, mind and soul with Princess®. From rejuvenating spa treatments and the tranquility of a top-deck retreat reserved just for adults to our state-of-the-art fitness centers, you’ll find all the elements for mind & body renewal.

blocks.heading: Kids, Teens & Family
blocks.text: From family-friendly stateroom options to enriching youth and family programs, quality time is time well spent. Onboard activities spark curiosity and fuel creativity while excursions ashore engage and inspire.

blocks.heading: Family
blocks.text: Princess makes it easy to sail together in comfort. There is a wide selection of staterooms accommodating up to four guests, and you’ll enjoy substantial savings on your third and fourth guests. There are also connecting stateroom options, as well as Two Bedroom Family Suites, with room for up to eight guests, which offer more living space, a balcony and two bathrooms, including a full bath tub.

blocks.heading: Just For Kids 3-7
blocks.text: Even the littlest guests will delight in this whimsical, forest-themed world that inspires playtime and invites exploration. Kids, ages 3 to 7, can dance, enjoy pajama movie nights, create art projects like puppets and masks or compete in a Lego® boat-building contest.

blocks.heading: Just For Kids 8-12
blocks.text: Inspired by the great outdoors, this cozy center keeps kids busy with games, dancing and kid-sized Olympic competitions. Their minds stay busy, too, with California Science Center programs like rocket building, or they can explore outer space with Stargazing and learning how to build a model roller coaster. Exciting events like talent shows, theme nights, and treasure hunts encourage new friendshi

blocks.heading: Just For Teens 13-17
blocks.text: This contemporary lounge is "the place" for teens — perfect for hanging out and socializing with late-night movie viewing, hip hop dance classes, video game tournaments and sports competitions like dodgeball and basketball. But that’s just the beginning. They’ll dazzle on the red carpet with our Rock the Boat teens-only party, complete with awards and "mocktails."

headings.text: Island Princess is your own private retreat on the sea

It’s sure to be your favorite way to dine at sea! Learn more

headings.text: Your guide to luxury and exotic escapes

blocks.heading: Your guide to luxury and exotic escapes
blocks.text: Enjoy sweeping views of the world while sailing on Crown Princess. From her nearly 900 balconies to the breathtaking three-story Piazza, you'll discover a relaxing atmosphere filled with an array of world class entertainment and dining options that will greet you each day when you return from making fascinating discoveries ashore.

blocks.text: Open 24-hours a day, the International Café located in the Piazza is the place for an ever-changing array of small bite meals, treats and gourmet beverages. Grab a freshly-baked croissant to start your day, snack on pies and quiche or choose from a wide variety of salads and sandwiches at lunchtime, and indulge in decadent deserts in the evening. Coffee and tea fans will love the Lavazza crafted c

blocks.heading: World Fresh Marketplace
blocks.text: Step beyond the traditional cruise buffet and experience a world of flavors. Learn more

blocks.heading: Slice Pizzeria

blocks.heading: Coffee & Cones

blocks.text: In the mood for a drink while soaking up the sun? Want your favorite treat while relaxing at the Piazza? Additional charge may apply.

blocks.text: Discover premium steakhouse dining at Crown Grill, where carefully aged cuts are prepared to perfection, complemented by a curated selection of gourmet salts and served in a refined, classic steakhouse setting.

blocks.heading: A taste of Italian tradition
blocks.text: Step inside Sabatini’s℠ Italian Trattoria and savor the craftsmanship behind every dish. Using artisanal techniques and fresh, select ingredients, our chefs celebrate the traditions that define true Italian cuisine. Enjoy the journey of flavor—one dish at a time.

blocks.heading: Ultimate Balcony Dining
blocks.text: A luxurious dining experience at sea all served right on the privacy of your own balcony by our dedicated waitstaff. Treat yourself to this unparalleled indulgence and savor food, views, and memories that will never be forgotten. Learn more

blocks.heading: Chef's Table
blocks.text: An extraordinary treat for both gastronomes and gourmet novices. The Chef’s Table is a perfect culinary journey for any special occasion. Indulge in an extravagant multi-course dinner created and hosted by the ship’s executive chef. Perfect for celebrating an anniversary or milestone, or just making your cruise vacation even more amazing. To remember the occasion a photo with the executive chef an

blocks.heading: Crab Shack
blocks.text: The Crab Shack is a unique pop-up dining experience with everything from clam chowder and popcorn shrimp to a steamer pot (crab legs, shrimp, clams!). Look for this lunchtime sensation in the Horizon Court. Learn more

blocks.heading: The Salty Dog Gastropub
blocks.text: A warm, inviting gastropub experience. Try one of our innovative gourmet creations inspired by pub favorites or devour a savory rib eye burger named “Best Burger at Sea” by Cruise Critic. Offering a unique variety of beer, whiskey and cocktail selections, plus live music, there’s something for everyone at this hip, friendly twist on traditional pub fare. Learn more

blocks.heading: Activities & Entertainment
blocks.text: Original musicals, dazzling magic shows, feature films, top comedians and nightclubs that get your feet movin’ and groovin’. There’s something happening around every corner; luckily, you have a whole cruise of days and nights to experience it all.

blocks.heading: The Shops of Princess
blocks.text: It’s no surprise The Shops are awarded “Best Onboard Shopping” from Porthole magazine year after year. On board, you’ll find a fabulous range of fine merchandise from brands like Swarovski, Chanel, Estée Lauder, Clinique, Lancôme, Calvin Klein, Citizen and Tissot, plus local crafts, keepsakes and souvenirs. And everyday tax- and duty-free savings can add up to as much as 30% off suggested U.S. ret

blocks.heading: The Piazza
blocks.text: Discover Old World charm as you stroll through our breathtaking Piazza—a hub of activity, inspired by the vibrant squares of Europe. Roving street performers, quaint boutiques, a spiral staircase and several glass-walled lifts provide panoramic views. Visit the International Café for gourmet coffees, or marvel at the wine selection at Vines, voted one of the “Best Wine Bars at Sea,” by USA Today.”

blocks.heading: Princess Theater
blocks.text: With dazzling stage sets, artists from around the globe, modern hits and timeless classics, the Princess Theater showcases lavish, original productions with dynamic cast members in sumptuous surroundings. blocks.heading: Vegas style casino

blocks.heading: Movies Under the Stars®
