blocks.heading: Music & dancing
blocks.text: When it comes to music and dancing we’ve got everything that your musical palette may desire. Whether it’s tapping your toes to cover bands, singing along in the piano bar, relaxing to classical strings or dancing the night away in Piazza, you’ll be satisfied.

blocks.heading: Pools & hot tubs
blocks.text: Take a dip in our sparkling pools and leave your everyday world behind. Unwind on a padded lounger and soak up the sun, catch up on reading, listen to music or dream of your next adventure on board or ashore. And what better way to relax and revitalize after a day exploring the world than a long soak in one of our whirling hot tubs.

blocks.heading: Top deck parties
blocks.text: For breathtaking ocean views and engaging opportunities to meet new friends and celebrate your voyage, no place beats the top deck. Under the sun or under the stars, top-deck parties welcome you to enjoy drinks and dancing, accompanied by a live band. And special themes give each party its own distinctive energy.

blocks.heading: Club Fusion
blocks.text: When the sun goes down and the moon comes up, it’s time to get your feet movin’ and your heart pumpin’ at Club Fusion. A little eclectic and a whole lot of fun, the dance floor lights and booming sound system invite you to get up and show off your moves and grooves. Karaoke contests, live performances and theme-parties are just a few of the nightly events that will have you on your feet.

blocks.heading: Skywalkers Nightclub
blocks.text: Hot music and cool cocktails set to a DJ spinning popular club tunes is the ideal setting for a night of dancing. Gleaming, ultra modern and ultra cool, this hot spot invites a little stargazing while the colorful neon dance floor invites everyone to get up and boogie down. Boasting panoramic views from its vantage point 15 decks above the sea, it’s the perfect place for dancing and socializing.

blocks.heading: Fine Arts Gallery
blocks.text: Great art, like the destinations we visit, can be awe-inspiring. Peruse our extensive art gallery, or attend an art history lecture highlighting some of the world’s greatest masters. And don’t miss our exciting Champagne Art Auctions, which give you the chance to view and bid on a wide range of fine art, including pieces by famous artists like Thomas Kinkade, Peter Max, and Michael Godard. There i

blocks.heading: Bars
blocks.text: Whether you're unwinding by the pool or raising a toast before dinner, our bars serve premium wines along with craft cocktails infused with local flavors, offering all the tastes you love.

blocks.heading: Vines Wine Bar
blocks.text: Voted one of the “Best Wine Bars at Sea,” by USA TODAY and located in a charming corner of the Piazza, Vines boasts an extensive collection of wines, fine Champagne and sparkling wines and regional offerings for purchase. The menu also includes wine flights and a selection of unique wines by the glass. Charges apply. Menu items may vary by ship and are subject to change. Learn more

blocks.heading: Good Spirits® At Sea
blocks.text: Good Spirits takes viewers around the globe in search of extraordinary everyday people, sharing stories of spirits and collecting farm-fresh, local ingredients to inspire one-of-a-kind cocktail creations. Immerse yourself in the region as skilled bartenders lead you through an immersive cocktail experience. Learn more

blocks.heading: Crooners
blocks.text: Step into Crooners bar and be transported to the classic Sinatra era, made complete with a top notch pianist singing tunes and tickling the ivories. The “Rat Pack” atmosphere and famous menu of signature martinis, and old-school mixed drinks will have you crooning. Learn more

blocks.heading: Wheelhouse Bar
blocks.text: Stop by the Wheelhouse Bar for pre-dinner drinks or post-performance libations. The menu offers a wide selection of classic cocktails, beers, wines, martinis and exclusive signature drinks. Learn more

blocks.heading: Staterooms
blocks.text: From the moment you step aboard, we want you to feel welcomed and right at home. And with attentive service from a friendly staff that knows what hospitality means, you’ll find your Princess® ship truly is your home away from home.

blocks.heading: Wellness
blocks.text: Revitalize and refresh body, mind and soul with Princess®. From rejuvenating spa treatments and the tranquility of a top-deck retreat reserved just for adults to our state-of-the-art fitness centers, you’ll find all the elements for mind & body renewal.

blocks.heading: Kids, Teens & Family
blocks.text: From family-friendly stateroom options to enriching youth and family programs, quality time is time well spent. Onboard activities spark curiosity and fuel creativity while excursions ashore engage and inspire.

blocks.heading: Family
blocks.text: Princess makes it easy to sail together in comfort. There is a wide selection of staterooms accommodating up to four guests, and you’ll enjoy substantial savings on your third and fourth guests. There are also connecting stateroom options, as well as Two Bedroom Family Suites, with room for up to eight guests, which offer more living space, a balcony and two bathrooms, including a full bath tub.

blocks.heading: Just For Kids 3-7
blocks.text: Even the littlest guests will delight in this whimsical, forest-themed world that inspires playtime and invites exploration. Kids, ages 3 to 7, can dance, enjoy pajama movie nights, create art projects like puppets and masks or compete in a Lego® boat-building contest.

blocks.heading: Just For Kids 8-12
blocks.text: Inspired by the great outdoors, this cozy center keeps kids busy with games, dancing and kid-sized Olympic competitions. Their minds stay busy, too, with California Science Center programs like rocket building, or they can explore outer space with Stargazing and learning how to build a model roller coaster. Exciting events like talent shows, theme nights, and treasure hunts encourage new friendshi

blocks.heading: Just For Teens 13-17
blocks.text: This contemporary lounge is "the place" for teens — perfect for hanging out and socializing with late-night movie viewing, hip hop dance classes, video game tournaments and sports competitions like dodgeball and basketball. But that’s just the beginning. They’ll dazzle on the red carpet with our Rock the Boat teens-only party, complete with awards and "mocktails."

blocks.heading: Welcome to the Sanctuary Collection
blocks.text: Discover serenity at sea. Now aboard Royal Princess, our exclusive Sanctuary Collection pairs luxurious accommodations with a world of elevated amenities. Unwind at the Sanctuary Club, a private top-deck retreat for adults with its own pool. Then enjoy a custom menu at the Sanctuary Restaurant, a dining room just for Sanctuary Collection guests.

blocks.heading: Every suite is now part of Sanctuary Collection
Unwind in a spacious Penthouse Suite
blocks.text: Enjoy the perfect balance of comfort and sophistication in your Penthouse Suite. Thoughtfully designed with generous living space, a separate sitting area and a private balcony, this inviting retreat offers room to relax, reconnect and take in the beauty of the sea. As part of Sanctuary Collection℠, you'll enjoy exclusive dining, events and entertainment, along with access to the dedicated Suite L

blocks.heading: Take in sweeping views from your Vista Suite
blocks.text: Relax in a spacious retreat thoughtfully designed for comfort and unforgettable ocean views. With a separate sitting area, ample room for up to four guests and a private balcony, the Vista Suite offers the perfect setting to unwind after a day of discovery. As part of Sanctuary Collection℠, you'll enjoy exclusive dining, events and entertainment, dedicated Suite Lounge access, and priority service

blocks.heading: Stretch out and savor every moment in your Signature Suite
blocks.text: Thoughtfully designed to bring together comfort and style, the Signature Suite offers a welcoming retreat for relaxing between adventures ashore. Floor-to-ceiling sliding glass doors open to an expansive private balcony, creating the perfect place for a quiet morning coffee or an unforgettable sunset. As part of Sanctuary Collection℠, you'll enjoy exclusive dining, events and entertainment, dedica

blocks.heading: A stateroom for every style
blocks.text: Sanctuary Collection extends to select Mini-Suites, Balconies, and now Oceanview staterooms. Beyond Sanctuary Collection, Royal Princess has staterooms for every taste and travel style. Choose a cozy Interior retreat, wake up to sea views, or relax on a private balcony. However you sail, you'll have a comfortable home at sea to return to after each day of discovery.

blocks.heading: When you can book and sail Sanctuary Collection
blocks.text: Book Sanctuary Collection on Royal Princess today, for voyages beginning January 4, 2027. More ships will join soon, each with its own booking date and onboard start date, so find your ship below and start charting your next voyage.

blocks.heading: Dining options
blocks.text: Indulge your appetite whenever you wish on board Princess®. Every hour, our chefs are busy baking, grilling and sautéing great-tasting fare from scratch. Princess offers unparalleled inclusive dining options throughout the ship with a wide range of culinary delights to suit any palate, from endless buffet choices to gourmet pizza, frosty treats, decadent desserts and much more.

blocks.heading: Afternoon Tea
blocks.text: Indulge in an elegant spread of freshly made finger sandwiches, delicate cookies, and decadent cakes, served with your choice of fine tea or coffee. Learn more

blocks.heading: Main Dining Room
blocks.text: Our main dining rooms give you the flexibility to choose so you can eat where, when and what you want. Choose from Traditional, Flexible, or Walk-in dining. There’s a menu to please any palate, created by our executive chefs and international culinary team throughout the fleet. Sail with us and savor every dish, from authentic Italian pastas to exclusive family favorites shared by world-renowned c

blocks.heading: Sanctuary Restaurant
blocks.text: Indulge in a refined culinary journey designed exclusively for Sanctuary Collection guests, where personalized service and carefully curated menus create an elevated dining experience. Learn more

blocks.heading: International Café
blocks.text: Open 24-hours a day, the International Café located in the Piazza is the place for an ever-changing array of small bite meals, treats and gourmet beverages. Grab a freshly-baked croissant to start your day, snack on pies and quiche or choose from a wide variety of salads and sandwiches at lunchtime, and indulge in decadent deserts in the evening. Coffee and tea fans will love the Lavazza crafted c

blocks.heading: World Fresh Marketplace
blocks.text: Step beyond the traditional cruise buffet and experience a world of flavors. Learn more

blocks.heading: Prego Pizzeria
blocks.text: A perennial Princess passenger favorite, Prego serves up freshly made Neopolitan-style pizza by the slice or by the whole pie. Named the "Best Pizza at Sea" by USA TODAY, you’ll savor classic favorites made with hand-tossed dough, fresh tomato sauce, cheeses and pepperoni or try the daily specials.

blocks.heading: Trident Grill
blocks.text: In addition to the hot dogs, hamburgers and chicken sandwiches that passengers love at the Trident Grill, this poolside eatery transforms into a traditional smokehouse-style barbecue each evening, serving up hearty plates of jumbo chicken wings, Route 66 beef chili, Texas-style barbecue brisket, Kansas City Sweet & Smoky Pork Spare Ribs, and North Carolina Pulled Pork. Enjoy delicious southern fla

blocks.heading: OceanNow® Delivery
blocks.text: In the mood for a drink while soaking up the sun? Want your favorite treat while relaxing at the Piazza? Order with OceanNow® from select locations onboard and have them delivered to you by using the Princess® app. Whether you’re in the Piazza, by the pool, or in your stateroom, we’ll find you. Additional charge may apply.

blocks.heading: Swirls Ice Cream Bar
blocks.text: Ice cream cones and fresh sea air await you at our top-deck creamery. Pick up a chocolate cone, a vanilla, or a combination. Or treat yourself to an ice cream sandwich or a specialty crafted coffee.

blocks.heading: Casual, specialty and culinary experiences
blocks.text: Dining on board a Princess® cruise ship is a joyful celebration and our specialty restaurants always deliver an extraordinary experience. They are among the best at sea – or anywhere. We serve dishes made with the freshest ingredients, and our menus reflect regional flavors from around the world. You'll find our specialty restaurants are the perfect place to celebrate any occasion. Additional char

blocks.heading: A signature steakhouse at sea
blocks.text: Discover premium steakhouse dining at Crown Grill, where carefully aged cuts are prepared to perfection, complemented by a curated selection of gourmet salts and served in a refined, classic steakhouse setting.

blocks.heading: A taste of Italian tradition
blocks.text: Step inside Sabatini’s℠ Italian Trattoria and savor the craftsmanship behind every dish. Using artisanal techniques and fresh, select ingredients, our chefs celebrate the traditions that define true Italian cuisine. Enjoy the journey of flavor—one dish at a time.

blocks.heading: Ultimate Balcony Dining
blocks.text: A luxurious breakfast experience at sea all served right on the privacy of your own balcony by our dedicated waitstaff. Treat yourself to this unparalleled indulgence and savor food, views, and memories that will never be forgotten. Learn more

blocks.heading: O'Malley's Irish Pub
blocks.text: Feel like you’ve stepped into a pub in Dublin at this warm, welcoming spot. It goes beyond the music, drinks and food, though you MUST try to the Dubliner Burger. It’s about the feeling you get when you’re here. It’s a bring-the-whole-gang-to-celebrate-a-birthday-or-watch-the-game kind of place. Rich browns and dark greens infuse the pub, named for a famous Irish pirate queen. Learn more

blocks.heading: Alfredo’s Pizzeria
blocks.text: Named for our former Master Chef, Alfredo Marzi and voted "Best Pizza at Sea" by USA TODAY, this charming sit-down venue offers an enticing menu of freshly prepared individual-size pizzas along with beer and wines by the glass. The open kitchen design allows you to watch as the chefs create pizza by hand and serve them straight out of the oven. Venues and menu items vary by ship and are subject to

blocks.heading: Chef’s Table Lumiere
blocks.text: An extraordinary treat for both gastronomes and gourmet novices, the Chef’s Table Lumiere is a perfect culinary journey for any special occasion. Indulge in champagne and hors d’oeuvres, followed by an extravagant multi-course dinner created and hosted by the ship’s executive chef. Perfect for celebrating an anniversary or milestone, or just making your cruise vacation even more amazing. Limited c

blocks.heading: Crab Shack
blocks.text: The Crab Shack is a unique pop-up dining experience with everything from clam chowder and popcorn shrimp to a steamer pot (crab legs, shrimp, clams!). Look for this lunchtime sensation in the Horizon Court. Learn more

blocks.heading: Caymus Winemaker's Dinner
blocks.text: We’re all about the wine. It’s why our onboard dining room received Wine Spectator’s 2023 Award of Excellence. Why we’ve invited iconic Napa Valley wineries – Silverado Vineyards and Caymus Vineyards – on board for chef-designed, multicourse meals. Why we offer 250+ labels and can always recommend the perfect pairing. If you love wine, you're in the right place. Reserve experiences through the Din

blocks.heading: Gelato
blocks.text: Get a taste of “la dolce vita” at Gelato, our gelateria on board. (Fun fact: gelato isn’t ice cream. While it’s creamy, it has less butter fat and fewer calories.) Choose from a variety of flavors – hazelnut, tiramisu, pistachio and more – which you can enjoy by themselves or in combination. Learn more

blocks.heading: Ocean Terrace seafood bar
blocks.text: The Ocean Terrace seafood bar is ideal for those who love to feast on the bounty from the sea. This stylish bar offers an array of ocean treasures, including sushi and sashimi along with chilled sake, cocktails, and wine by the glass. A la carte pricing makes it easy to pick and choose. Menu items may vary by ship and are subject to change. Learn more

blocks.heading: Activities & Entertainment
blocks.text: Original musicals, dazzling magic shows, feature films, top comedians and nightclubs that get your feet movin’ and groovin’. There’s something happening around every corner; luckily, you have a whole cruise of days and nights to experience it all.

blocks.heading: The Shops of Princess
blocks.text: It’s no surprise The Shops are awarded “Best Onboard Shopping” from Porthole magazine year after year. On board, you’ll find a fabulous range of fine merchandise from brands like Swarovski, Chanel, Estée Lauder, Clinique, Lancôme, Calvin Klein, Citizen and Tissot, plus local crafts, keepsakes and souvenirs. And everyday tax- and duty-free savings can add up to as much as 30% off suggested U.S. ret

blocks.heading: The Piazza
blocks.text: Discover Old World charm as you stroll through our breathtaking Piazza—a hub of activity, inspired by the vibrant squares of Europe. Roving street performers, quaint boutiques, a spiral staircase and several glass-walled lifts provide panoramic views. Visit the International Café for gourmet coffees, or marvel at the wine selection at Vines, voted one of the “Best Wine Bars at Sea,” by USA Today.

blocks.heading: Princess Theater
blocks.text: With dazzling stage sets, artists from around the globe, modern hits and timeless classics, the Princess Theater showcases lavish, original productions with dynamic cast members in sumptuous surroundings. In this ultramodern theater, relax in a plush seat with unobstructed sight lines as the velvet curtain goes up, a state-of-the-art lighting system illuminates the stage, and it’s on with the show

blocks.heading: Vegas style casino
blocks.text: From gaming lessons to the latest slot machines to prize tournaments, our Casinos offer fun and excitement. If you enjoy blackjack, or “21,” and Texas Hold 'Em, our tables play by Vegas rules and if you relish the challenge of roulette, we offer the American version.

blocks.heading: Movies Under the Stars®
blocks.text: Throughout the day and night, our exclusive open-air poolside amphitheater is the go-to destination for feature films, thrilling concerts and exciting sporting events such as live football games. Cozy up under a fleece blanket in the comfortable lounger and feast on complimentary fresh-popped popcorn in the evening or delicious cookies and milk during the day, and enjoy that exciting car chase or

blocks.heading: Music & dancing
blocks.text: When it comes to music and dancing we’ve got everything that your musical palette may desire. Whether it’s tapping your toes to cover bands, singing along in the piano bar, relaxing to classical strings or dancing the night away in Piazza, you’ll be satisfied.

blocks.heading: Pools & hot tubs
blocks.text: Take a dip in our sparkling pools and leave your everyday world behind. Unwind on a padded lounger and soak up the sun, catch up on reading, listen to music or dream of your next adventure on board or ashore. And what better way to relax and revitalize after a day exploring the world than a long soak in one of our whirling hot tubs.

blocks.heading: Top deck parties
blocks.text: For breathtaking ocean views and engaging opportunities to meet new friends and celebrate your voyage, no place beats the top deck. Under the sun or under the stars, top-deck parties welcome you to enjoy drinks and dancing, accompanied by a live band. And special themes give each party its own distinctive energy.

blocks.heading: Princess Live
blocks.text: By day experience for interactive events and presentations. By night, enjoy stellar entertainment like cabaret acts, comedians, concerts and game shows. There's always something new happening at Princess Live!

blocks.heading: Fine Arts Gallery
blocks.text: Great art, like the destinations we visit, can be awe-inspiring. Peruse our extensive art gallery, or attend an art history lecture highlighting some of the world’s greatest masters. And don’t miss our exciting Champagne Art Auctions, which give you the chance to view and bid on a wide range of fine art, including pieces by famous artists like Thomas Kinkade, Peter Max, and Michael Godard. There i

blocks.heading: Bars
blocks.text: Whether you're unwinding by the pool or raising a toast before dinner, our bars serve premium wines along with craft cocktails infused with local flavors, offering all the tastes you love.

blocks.heading: Wheelhouse Bar
blocks.text: Stop by the Wheelhouse Bar for pre-dinner drinks or post-performance libations. The menu offers a wide selection of classic cocktails, beers, wines, martinis and exclusive signature drinks. Learn more

blocks.heading: Good Spirits® At Sea
blocks.text: Good Spirits takes viewers around the globe in search of extraordinary everyday people, sharing stories of spirits and collecting farm-fresh, local ingredients to inspire one-of-a-kind cocktail creations. Immerse yourself in the region as skilled bartenders lead you through an immersive cocktail experience. Learn more

blocks.heading: Crooners
blocks.text: Step into Crooners bar and be transported to the classic Sinatra era, made complete with a top notch pianist singing tunes and tickling the ivories. The “Rat Pack” atmosphere and famous menu of signature martinis, and old-school mixed drinks will have you crooning. Learn more

blocks.heading: Bellini's
blocks.text: Take in views of the Piazza as you sip a Bellini-inspired specialty cocktail, Champagne, sparkling wine or other fizzy beverage. This stylish bar boasts an Italian flair and a prime location. Perfect for a pre- or post-dinner drink. Learn more

blocks.heading: Wellness
blocks.text: Revitalize and refresh body, mind and soul with Princess®. From rejuvenating spa treatments and the tranquility of a top-deck retreat reserved just for adults to our state-of-the-art fitness centers, you’ll find all the elements for mind & body renewal.

blocks.heading: Kids, Teens & Family
blocks.text: From family-friendly stateroom options to enriching youth and family programs, quality time is time well spent. Onboard activities spark curiosity and fuel creativity while excursions ashore engage and inspire!

blocks.heading: Family
blocks.text: Princess makes it easy to sail together in comfort. There is a wide selection of staterooms accommodating up to four guests, and you’ll enjoy substantial savings on your third and fourth guests. There are also connecting stateroom options, as well as Two Bedroom Family Suites, with room for up to eight guests, which offer more living space, a balcony and two bathrooms, including a full bath tub.

blocks.heading: Just For Kids 3-7
blocks.text: Even the littlest guests will delight in this whimsical, forest-themed world that inspires playtime and invites exploration. Kids, ages 3 to 7, can dance, enjoy pajama movie nights, create art projects like puppets and masks or compete in a Lego® boat-building contest.

blocks.heading: Just For Kids 8-12
blocks.text: Inspired by the great outdoors, this cozy center keeps kids busy with games, dancing and kid-sized Olympic competitions. Their minds stay busy, too, with California Science Center programs like rocket building, or they can explore outer space with Stargazing and learning how to build a model roller coaster. Exciting events like talent shows, theme nights, and treasure hunts encourage new friendshi

blocks.heading: Just For Teens 13-17
blocks.text: This contemporary lounge is "the place" for teens — perfect for hanging out and socializing with late-night movie viewing, hip hop dance classes, video game tournaments and sports competitions like dodgeball and basketball. But that’s just the beginning. They’ll dazzle on the red carpet with our Rock the Boat teens-only party, complete with awards and "mocktails."

headings.text: Sail to a world of relaxation and adventure

This Love Boat offers nearly 900 balconies from which to view the world, an array of entertainment options including Movies Under the Stars®, and sumptuous dining choices from Crown Grill to the International Café.

Karaoke contests, live performances and theme-parties are just a few of the nightly events that will have you on your feet.

blocks.text: Hot music and cool cocktails set to a DJ spinning popular club tunes is the ideal setting for a night of dancing. Gleaming, ultra modern and ultra cool, this hot spot invites a little stargazing while the colorful neon dance floor invites everyone to get up and boogie down. Boasting panoramic views from its vantage point 15 decks above the sea, it’s the perfect place for dancing and socializing.

blocks.text: Voted one of the “Best Wine Bars at Sea,” by USA TODAY and located in a charming corner of the Piazza, Vines boasts an extensive collection of wines, fine Champagne and sparkling wines and regional offerings for purchase. The menu also includes wine flights and a selection of unique wines by the glass. Charges apply. Menu items may vary by ship and are subject to change. Learn more

Immerse yourself in the region as skilled bartenders lead you through an immersive cocktail experience. Learn more

blocks.heading: Crooners
blocks.text: Step into Crooners bar and be transported to the classic Sinatra era, made complete with a top notch pianist singing tunes and tickling the ivories. The “Rat Pack” atmosphere and famous menu of signature martinis, and old-school mixed drinks will have you crooning. Learn more

blocks.heading: Wheelhouse Bar
blocks.text: Stop by the Wheelhouse Bar for pre-dinner drinks or post-performance libations. The menu offers a wide selection of classic cocktails, beers, wines, martinis and exclusive signature drinks. Learn more

blocks.heading: Staterooms
blocks.text: From the moment you step aboard, we want you to feel welcomed and right at home. And with attentive service from a friendly staff that knows what hospitality means, you’ll find your Princess® ship truly is your home away from home.

blocks.heading: Wellness
blocks.text: Revitalize and refresh body, mind and soul with Princess®. From rejuvenating spa treatments and the tranquility of a top-deck retreat reserved just for adults to our state-of-the-art fitness centers, you’ll find all the elements for mind & body renewal.

blocks.heading: Kids, Teens & Family
blocks.text: From family-friendly stateroom options to enriching youth and family programs, quality time is time well spent. Onboard activities spark curiosity and fuel creativity while excursions ashore engage and inspire.

blocks.heading: Family
blocks.text: Princess makes it easy to sail together in comfort. There is a wide selection of staterooms accommodating up to four guests, and you’ll enjoy substantial savings on your third and fourth guests. There are also connecting stateroom options, as well as Two Bedroom Family Suites, with room for up to eight guests, which offer more living space, a balcony and two bathrooms, including a full bath tub.

blocks.heading: Just For Kids 3-7
blocks.text: Even the littlest guests will delight in this whimsical, forest-themed world that inspires playtime and invites exploration. Kids, ages 3 to 7, can dance, enjoy pajama movie nights, create art projects like puppets and masks or compete in a Lego® boat-building contest.

blocks.heading: Just For Kids 8-12
blocks.text: Inspired by the great outdoors, this cozy center keeps kids busy with games, dancing and kid-sized Olympic competitions. Their minds stay busy, too, with California Science Center programs like rocket building, or they can explore outer space with Stargazing and learning how to build a model roller coaster. Exciting events like talent shows, theme nights, and treasure hunts encourage new friendshi

blocks.heading: Just For Teens 13-17
blocks.text: This contemporary lounge is "the place" for teens — perfect for hanging out and socializing with late-night movie viewing, hip hop dance classes, video game tournaments and sports competitions like dodgeball and basketball. But that’s just the beginning. They’ll dazzle on the red carpet with our Rock the Boat teens-only party, complete with awards and "mocktails."

pages.title: Sapphire Princess - Cruise Ship Information - Princess Cruises
pages.metaDescription: Discover luxurious accommodations, specialty dining and more aboard the Sapphire Princess®. Start your sea-going getaway from one of 700 private balconies.

headings.text: From sumptuous dining to captivating diversions, discover the many riches of this gem

blocks.heading: From sumptuous dining to captivating diversions, discover the many riches of this gem
blocks.text: As you set your sights on the wonders of the world, let Sapphire Princess indulge your every whim. Over 700 balconies, world-class gourmet dining and dazzling entertainment options are just the beginning of your sea-going adventure. Dance the night away, enjoy casino gaming or relax and rejuvenate body and mind at the Lotus Spa®.

blocks.heading: Dining options
blocks.text: Indulge your appetite whenever you wish on board Princess®. Every hour, our chefs are busy baking, grilling and sautéing great-tasting fare from scratch. Princess offers unparalleled inclusive dining options throughout the ship with a wide range of culinary delights to suit any palate, from endless buffet choices to gourmet pizza, frosty treats, decadent desserts and much more.

blocks.heading: Afternoon Tea
blocks.text: Indulge in an elegant spread of freshly made finger sandwiches, delicate cookies, and decadent cakes, served with your choice of fine tea or coffee. Learn more

blocks.heading: Main Dining Room
blocks.text: Our main dining rooms give you the flexibility to choose so you can eat where, when and what you want. Choose from Traditional, Flexible, or Walk-in dining. There’s a menu to please any palate, created by our executive chefs and international culinary team throughout the fleet. Sail with us and savor every dish, from authentic Italian pastas to exclusive family favorites shared by world-renowned c

blocks.heading: Reserve Collection Dining
blocks.text: There’s nothing quite like the Reserve Dining experience. Think private entrance to an exclusive area in the main dining room. Expedited seating and dining on your schedule, no reservations needed. Menu options chosen just for you, including a daily chef’s special. And a dedicated waitstaff to respond to your every request. It’s sure to be your favorite way to dine at sea. Learn more

blocks.heading: World Fresh Marketplace
blocks.text: Step beyond the traditional cruise buffet and experience a world of flavors. Learn more

blocks.heading: Prego Pizzeria
blocks.text: A perennial Princess passenger favorite, Prego serves up freshly made Neopolitan-style pizza by the slice or by the whole pie. Named the "Best Pizza at Sea" by USA TODAY, you’ll savor classic favorites made with hand-tossed dough, fresh tomato sauce, cheeses and pepperoni or try the daily specials.

blocks.heading: Trident Grill
blocks.text: In addition to the hot dogs, hamburgers and chicken sandwiches that passengers love at the Trident Grill, this poolside eatery transforms into a traditional smokehouse-style barbecue each evening, serving up hearty plates of jumbo chicken wings, Route 66 beef chili, Texas-style barbecue brisket, Kansas City Sweet & Smoky Pork Spare Ribs, and North Carolina Pulled Pork. Enjoy delicious southern fla

blocks.heading: OceanNow® Delivery
blocks.text: In the mood for a drink while soaking up the sun? Want your favorite treat while relaxing at the Piazza? Order with OceanNow® from select locations onboard and have them delivered to you by using the Princess® app. Whether you’re in the Piazza, by the pool, or in your stateroom, we’ll find you. Additional charge may apply.

blocks.heading: Swirls Ice Cream Bar
blocks.text: Ice cream cones and fresh sea air await you at our top-deck creamery. Pick up a chocolate cone, a vanilla, or a combination. Or treat yourself to an ice cream sandwich or a specialty crafted coffee.

blocks.heading: International Café
blocks.text: Open 24-hours a day, the International Café located in the Piazza is the place for an ever-changing array of small bite meals, treats and gourmet beverages. Grab a freshly baked croissant to start your day, snack on pies and quiche or choose from a wide variety of salads and sandwiches at lunchtime, and indulge in decadent desserts in the evening. Coffee and tea fans will love the New Grounds Craf

blocks.heading: Casual, specialty and culinary experiences
blocks.text: Dining on board a Princess® cruise ship is a joyful celebration and our specialty restaurants always deliver an extraordinary experience. They are among the best at sea – or anywhere. We serve dishes made with the freshest ingredients, and our menus reflect regional flavors from around the world. You'll find our specialty restaurants are the perfect place to celebrate any occasion. Additional char

blocks.heading: A signature steakhouse at sea
blocks.text: Discover premium steakhouse dining at Crown Grill, where carefully aged cuts are prepared to perfection, complemented by a curated selection of gourmet salts and served in a refined, classic steakhouse setting.

blocks.heading: A taste of Italian tradition
blocks.text: Step inside Sabatini’s℠ Italian Trattoria and savor the craftsmanship behind every dish. Using artisanal techniques and fresh, select ingredients, our chefs celebrate the traditions that define true Italian cuisine. Enjoy the journey of flavor—one dish at a time.

blocks.heading: Ultimate balcony dining
blocks.text: A luxurious dinning experience at sea all served right on the privacy of your own balcony by our dedicated waitstaff. Treat yourself to this unparalleled indulgence and savor food, views, and memories that will never be forgotten. Learn more

blocks.heading: Makoto Ocean
blocks.text: Indulge in renowned chef Makoto Okuwa’s playful and exquisitely presented dishes that pay tribute to Japanese culinary traditions. Learn more

blocks.heading: Churrascaria Brazilian Grill
blocks.text: It’s dining with a side of excitement at the all-new Churrascaria Brazilian Grill. Quality meats boasting bold South American flavors are cooked to perfection in the tasty tradition of grilling churrasco style. Then our servers present these flavorful cuts on vertical skewers — and hand-carve them right onto your plate. Filet mignon, barbecued pork ribs, leg of lamb ... enjoy them all. Connect, si

blocks.heading: Alfredo's Pizzeria
blocks.text: Named for our former Master Chef, Alfredo Marzi and voted "Best Pizza at Sea" by USA TODAY, this charming sit-down venue offers an enticing menu of freshly prepared individual-size pizzas along with beer and wines by the glass. The open kitchen design allows you to watch as the chefs create pizza by hand and serve them straight out of the oven. Learn more

blocks.heading: Chef's Table Experience
blocks.text: An extraordinary treat for both gastronomes and gourmet novices. The Chef’s Table is a perfect culinary journey for any special occasion. Indulge in an extravagant multi-course dinner created and hosted by the ship’s executive chef. Perfect for celebrating an anniversary or milestone, or just making your cruise vacation even more amazing. To remember the occasion a photo with the executive chef an

blocks.heading: Crab Shack
blocks.text: The Crab Shack is a unique pop-up dining experience with everything from clam chowder and popcorn shrimp to a steamer pot (crab legs, shrimp, clams!). Look for this lunchtime sensation in the Horizon Court. Learn more

blocks.heading: Activities & Entertainment
blocks.text: Original musicals, dazzling magic shows, feature films, top comedians and nightclubs that get your feet movin’ and groovin’. There’s something happening around every corner; luckily, you have a whole cruise of days and nights to experience it all.

blocks.heading: Fine Arts Gallery
blocks.text: Great art, like the destinations we visit, can be awe-inspiring. Peruse our extensive art gallery, or attend an art history lecture highlighting some of the world’s greatest masters. And don’t miss our exciting Champagne Art Auctions, which give you the chance to view and bid on a wide range of fine art, including pieces by famous artists like Thomas Kinkade, Peter Max, and Michael Godard. There i

blocks.heading: The Piazza
blocks.text: Discover Old World charm as you stroll through our breathtaking Piazza—a hub of activity, inspired by the vibrant squares of Europe. Roving street performers, quaint boutiques, a spiral staircase and several glass-walled lifts provide panoramic views. Kick back with a cocktail from Crooners, listen to live music or stroll The Shops of Princess.

blocks.heading: Princess Theater
blocks.text: With dazzling stage sets, artists from around the globe, modern hits and timeless classics, the Princess Theater showcases lavish, original productions with dynamic cast members in sumptuous surroundings. In this ultramodern theater, relax in a plush seat with unobstructed sight lines as the velvet curtain goes up, a state-of-the-art lighting system illuminates the stage, and it’s on with the show

blocks.heading: Vegas style casino
blocks.text: From gaming lessons to the latest slot machines to prize tournaments, our Casinos offer fun and excitement. If you enjoy blackjack, or “21,” and Texas Hold 'Em, our tables play by Vegas rules and if you relish the challenge of roulette, we offer the American version.

blocks.heading: Movies Under the Stars®
blocks.text: Throughout the day and night, our exclusive open-air poolside amphitheater is the go-to destination for feature films, thrilling concerts and exciting sporting events such as live football games. Cozy up under a fleece blanket in the comfortable lounger and feast on complimentary fresh-popped popcorn in the evening or delicious cookies and milk during the day, and enjoy that exciting car chase or

blocks.heading: Music & Dancing
blocks.text: When it comes to music and dancing we’ve got everything that your musical palette may desire. Whether it’s tapping your toes to cover bands, singing along in the piano bar, relaxing to classical strings or dancing the night away in the nightclub, you’ll be satisfied.

blocks.heading: Pools & Hot Tubs
blocks.text: Take a dip in our sparkling pools and leave your everyday world behind. Unwind on a padded lounger and soak up the sun, catch up on reading, listen to music or dream of your next adventure on board or ashore. And what better way to relax and revitalize after a day exploring the world than a long soak in one of our whirling hot tubs.

blocks.heading: Skywalkers Nightclub
blocks.text: Hot music and cool cocktails set to a DJ spinning popular club tunes is the ideal setting for a night of dancing. Gleaming, ultra modern and ultra cool, this hot spot invites a little stargazing while the colorful neon dance floor invites everyone to get up and boogie down. Boasting panoramic views from its vantage point 15 decks above the sea, it’s the perfect place for dancing and socializing.

blocks.heading: Bars
blocks.text: Whether you're unwinding by the pool or raising a toast before dinner, our bars serve premium wines along with craft cocktails infused with local flavors, offering all the tastes you love.

blocks.heading: Vines Wines Bar
blocks.text: Voted one of the “Best Wine Bars at Sea,” by USA TODAY and located in a charming corner of the Atrium, Vines boasts an extensive collection of wines, fine Champagne and sparkling wines and regional offerings for purchase. The menu also includes wine flights and a selection of unique wines by the glass. Gourmet delicacies, such as antipasti and tapas, are complimentary with any wine purchase. Learn

blocks.heading: Panoramic views from a sphere of glass
blocks.text: Enjoy ocean views in every direction while relaxing and dining in the Piazza.

blocks.heading: The Arena that brings theater to a whole new level
Dinner with a view— and then some
blocks.text: Feast on a multi-course meal in our elegant, three-story dining room.

blocks.heading: Sanctuary: a secluded setting to stay and indulge
blocks.text: Kick back in our exclusive Sanctuary Collection. All of the Suites on Star Princess are part of the Sanctuary Collection with access to all its wonderful amenities.

blocks.heading: Suites with plenty of space to unwind
Sanctuary Balcony
blocks.text: This inspired stateroom offers the added indulgence of a large private balcony. The perfect setting for cocktails before dinner or a leisurely breakfast.

blocks.heading: Elevated accommodations for Sun and Star
blocks.text: Create unforgettable memories in accommodations designed for the whole group.

blocks.heading: All new Cabana Mini-Suites
blocks.text: Take in the sea air from your balcony and private indoor-outdoor cabana. Deck 9 cabanas include access to an exclusive star deck.

blocks.heading: Flavors that shine through
blocks.text: Whether you live to eat or eat to live, you'll love it all, with exciting new options and favorites made even better.

blocks.heading: Love by Britto
blocks.text: This unique dining experience features world-renowned artist Romero Britto's showcase. You'll enjoy his art against the backdrop of a boutique restaurant with a menu by exquisite chef Rudi Sodamin.

blocks.heading: Entertaining eats and sumptuous sips
blocks.text: Specialty, casual and complimentary dining with something for everyone

blocks.heading: So much more to eat, drink, and experience
Take your journey farther with a package
blocks.text: Save on drinks, Wi-Fi, crew appreciation, and more when you add a package to your booking.

blocks.heading: Princess Premier®
blocks.text: Sail as carefree as possible with maximum savings on the best dining and drinks.

blocks.heading: Princess Plus®
blocks.text: Save on the things you love most‎.

blocks.heading: Complimentary dining
blocks.text: Always included, these elevated spaces offer something to please every palette. A few favorites:

blocks.heading: International Cafe
blocks.text: Quick bites and your favorite specialty coffee available 24 hours a day.

blocks.heading: Main Dining Room
blocks.text: An elegant design, multicourse meals guests rave about and a different experience for each level.

blocks.heading: The Eatery
blocks.text: Where a world of flavors comes to life with an ever-changing menu showcasing regional specialties and comforting favorites.

blocks.heading: Americana Diner
blocks.text: From timeless bites to nostalgic sides, Americana Diner serves classic favorites all day long.​

blocks.heading: The Promenade and more
blocks.text: Snacks for the in-between times that are always a special treat

blocks.heading: Coffee & Cones
blocks.text: Indulge in a delicious ice cream treat or coffee concoction at our top-deck creamery.

blocks.heading: Specialty restaurants
blocks.text: Award-winning, multi-course meals perfect for celebrating a special occasion (or just being together). Highlights include:

blocks.heading: Umai Hot Pot
blocks.text: Gather around the table and enjoy the authentic flavors of Japan at Umai Hot Pot. Learn more

blocks.heading: Crown Grill
blocks.text: A refined steakhouse that serves aged and hand-cut, cooked-to-order steaks and premium seafood. Learn more

blocks.heading: Sabatini's Italian Trattoria
blocks.text: Traditional handmade pasta, authentic sauces and hearty main courses made from time-honored family recipes. Learn more

blocks.heading: The Catch by Rudi
blocks.text: A celebration of all things ocean, from the menu to the setting, from Chef Rudi Sodamin, head of culinary arts. Learn more

blocks.heading: The Butcher’s Block by Dario
blocks.text: Get your fill of the grill with perfectly prepared beef and steak, including famed butcher Dario Cecchini’s signature cuts. Learn more

blocks.heading: Umai Teppanyaki
blocks.text: Savor a fusion of world-class Japanese cuisine, including Teppanyaki and Hot Pot. Learn more

blocks.heading: Makoto Ocean
blocks.text: Indulge in renowned chef Makoto Okuwa’s playful and exquisitely presented dishes that pay tribute to Japanese culinary traditions. Learn more

blocks.heading: Casual Dining
blocks.text: Relaxed, sit-down meals at a variety of eateries, with something for everyone. Highlights include:

blocks.heading: O'Malley's Irish Pub
blocks.text: Everything you'd expect from an Irish pub: great food, great drinks, lively music, and a welcoming atmosphere.

blocks.heading: Alfredo's Pizzeria
blocks.text: Our signature pizzeria, certified by Ospitalità Italiana for authentic excellence, features an open kitchen and charming sit-down dining offering freshly handcrafted pizzas, beer, and wine by the glass. ‎

blocks.heading: Our largest-ever casino
blocks.text: We've leveled up our Vegas-caliber gaming with our expanded Princess Casino.

blocks.heading: The Lotus Spa®
blocks.text: Relax and recharge in our award-winning Lotus Spa® The onboard Lotus Spa® features a wide range of treatments for full relaxation and harmony. The spa operates "a la carte,” where each service can be booked separately – letting you customize your own perfect spa day (or days).

blocks.heading: SkyDeck Sports Court & Track
blocks.text: Recharge and play in reimagined top deck spaces.

blocks.heading: The Cove
blocks.text: A fantastic spot to relax, whether you’re soaking up the sun or enjoying spectacular glacier views.

blocks.heading: Multi-sports court
blocks.text: Challenge friends and family to your favorite court games like pickelball or basketball.

blocks.heading: Jogging track
blocks.text: Take a stroll around the jogging track, where 7 laps equals one mile.

blocks.heading: Splash pad
blocks.text: This interactive water feature is the perfect place to relax and have fun with the whole family.

blocks.heading: Spellbound By Magic Castle
blocks.text: Delight in this one-of-a-kind experience that features magicians, themed rooms and theatrical cocktails.

blocks.heading: An all-new way to be Spellbound
blocks.text: Pay homage to "The Great Cardini" in a speakeasy bar that mixes magic with mixology.

blocks.heading: The Peacock Theater
blocks.text: Come for the drinks, stay for the show featuring magicians straight from Hollywood’s The Magic Castle®.

blocks.heading: Ticket Booth
blocks.text: Step right up and say the magic word to unlock the mystery of Spellbound.

blocks.heading: Inner Circle
blocks.text: Experience the thrill of enchanting music paired with mesmerizing close-up magic unfolding right before your eyes.

blocks.heading: Cardini’s Bar
blocks.text: Bartenders dazzle with premium cocktails and sleight-of-hand.

blocks.heading: Backstage
blocks.text: Explore the backstage area, adorned with eclectic memorabilia from past performers and surprises in every corner.

blocks.heading: Viva La Música
blocks.text: At this exciting musical experience, a couple invites guests to join them on the floor for an immersive dancing experience.

blocks.heading: Illuminate
blocks.text: Step into an extraordinary world where a traditional circus tent transforms into a realm of magical performances.

blocks.heading: Meridian
blocks.text: Set aboard a grand ship bound for a new land, follow the compelling story of a young woman caught between duty and desire.

pages.title: Sun Princess - Cruise Ship Information - Princess Cruises
pages.metaDescription: Introducing Sun Princess®, our newest sailing next-generation cruise ship designed for you to feel the love as everything revolves around you. Learn more here!

The Arena that brings theater to a whole new level
Dinner with a view— and then some
Sanctuary Suites have plenty of space to unwind
Elevated accommodations for Sun and Star

Plan a vacation that's out of this world

blocks.heading: Panoramic views from a sphere of glass
blocks.text: Enjoy ocean views in every direction while relaxing and dining in the Piazza.

blocks.heading: The Arena that brings theater to a whole new level
Dinner with a view— and then some
blocks.text: Feast on a multi-course meal in our elegant, three-story dining room.

blocks.heading: Sanctuary Suites have plenty of space to unwind
blocks.text: Kick back in our exclusive Sanctuary Collection—reimagined for Sun Princess. All of our Suites are part of the Sanctuary Collection with access to all of its wonderful amenities.

blocks.heading: Sky Suite
blocks.text: Spread out in our most expansive stateroom and balcony, with two bedrooms and access to Sanctuary areas.

blocks.heading: Elevated accommodations for Sun and Star
blocks.text: Create unforgettable memories in accommodations designed for the whole group.

blocks.heading: All new Cabana Mini-Suites
blocks.text: Take in the sea air from your balcony and private indoor-outdoor cabana. Deck 9 cabanas include access to an exclusive sun deck.

blocks.heading: Flavors that shine through
blocks.text: Whether you live to eat or eat to live, you'll love it all, with exciting new options and favorites made even better.

blocks.heading: Love by Britto
blocks.text: This unique dining experience features world-renowned artist Romero Britto's showcase. You'll enjoy his art against the backdrop of a boutique restaurant with a menu by exquisite chef Rudi Sodamin.

blocks.heading: Entertaining eats and sumptuous sips
blocks.text: Specialty, casual and complementary dining with something for everyone

blocks.heading: So much more to eat, drink, and experience
Take your journey farther with a package
blocks.text: Save on drinks, Wi-Fi, crew appreciation, and more when you add a package to your booking.

blocks.heading: Princess Premier®
blocks.text: Sail as carefree as possible with maximum savings on the best dining and drinks.

blocks.heading: Princess Plus®
blocks.text: Save on the things you love most‎.

blocks.heading: Complimentary dining
blocks.text: Always included, these elevated spaces offer something to please every palette. A few favorites:

blocks.heading: International Cafe
blocks.text: Quick bites and your favorite specialty coffee available 24 hours a day.

blocks.heading: Main Dining Room
blocks.text: An elegant design, multicourse meals guests rave about and a different experience for each level. Learn more

blocks.heading: The Eatery
blocks.text: Where a world of flavors comes to life with an ever-changing menu showcasing regional specialties and comforting favorites.

blocks.heading: Americana Diner
blocks.text: From timeless bites to nostalgic sides, Americana Diner serves classic favorites all day long.​

blocks.heading: The Promenade and more
blocks.text: Snacks for the in-between times that are always a special treat

blocks.heading: Coffee & Cones
blocks.text: Indulge in a delicious ice cream treat or coffee concoction at our top-deck creamery.

blocks.heading: Specialty restaurants
blocks.text: Award-winning, multi-course meals perfect for celebrating a special occasion (or just being together). Highlights include:

blocks.heading: Umai Hot Pot
blocks.text: Gather around the table and enjoy the authentic flavors of Japan at Umai Hot Pot. Learn more

blocks.heading: Crown Grill
blocks.text: A refined steakhouse that serves aged and hand-cut, cooked-to-order steaks and premium seafood. Learn more

blocks.heading: Sabatini's Italian Trattoria
blocks.text: Traditional handmade pasta, authentic sauces and hearty main courses made from time-honored family recipes. Learn more

blocks.heading: The Catch by Rudi
blocks.text: A celebration of all things ocean, from the menu to the setting, from Chef Rudi Sodamin, head of culinary arts. Learn more

blocks.heading: The Butcher’s Block by Dario
blocks.text: Get your fill of the grill with perfectly prepared beef and steak, including famed butcher Dario Cecchini’s signature cuts. Learn more

blocks.heading: Umai Teppanyaki
blocks.text: Savor a fusion of world-class Japanese cuisine, including Teppanyaki and Hot Pot. Learn more

blocks.heading: Makoto Ocean
blocks.text: Indulge in renowned chef Makoto Okuwa’s playful and exquisitely presented dishes that pay tribute to Japanese culinary traditions. Learn more

blocks.heading: Casual Dining
blocks.text: Relaxed, sit-down meals at a variety of eateries, with something for everyone. Highlights include:

blocks.heading: O'Malley's Irish Pub
blocks.text: Everything you'd expect from an Irish pub: great food, great drinks, lively music, and a welcoming atmosphere.

blocks.heading: Alfredo's Pizzeria
blocks.text: Our signature pizzeria, certified by Ospitalità Italiana for authentic excellence, features an open kitchen and charming sit-down dining offering freshly handcrafted pizzas, beer, and wine by the glass. ‎

blocks.heading: Our largest-ever casino
blocks.text: We've leveled up our Vegas-caliber gaming with our expanded Princess Casino, featuring the first “Buffalo Zone” at sea.

blocks.heading: The Lotus Spa®
blocks.text: Relax and recharge in our award-winning Lotus Spa® The onboard Lotus Spa® features a wide range of treatments for full relaxation and harmony. The spa operates "a la carte,” where each service can be booked separately – letting you customize your own perfect spa day (or days).

blocks.heading: Spellbound By Magic Castle
blocks.text: Delight in this one-of-a-kind experience that features magicians, themed rooms and theatrical cocktails.

blocks.heading: Stage Struck
blocks.text: Revel in this celebration of musical theater that revisits old favorites.‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎

blocks.heading: Fiera!
blocks.text: Talented performers bring a medley of popular songs to life, dancing on a vibrant set.‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎

blocks.heading: Viva La Música
blocks.text: At this exciting musical experience, a couple invites guests to join them on the floor for an immersive dancing experience.

pages.title: Discovery Princess - Cruise Ship Information - Princess Cruises
pages.metaDescription: Discover luxury amenities on the Discovery Princess cruise ship, offering comfort, entertainment and relaxation for an unforgettable escape at sea.

blocks.heading: So much to Discover
blocks.text: Enjoy sweeping views from one of more than 1,400 balconies on Discovery Princess, including 270-degree views in the Sky Suites, our largest balconies at sea. Unwind in ultimate comfort at the tranquil Sanctuary, a retreat reserved for adults. Indulge your senses with Princess dining favorites and enjoy innovative new dining options such as The Catch by Rudi. Plus, Princess live entertainment prese

blocks.heading: Dining options
blocks.text: Indulge your appetite whenever you wish on board Princess®. Every hour, our chefs are busy baking, grilling and sautéing great-tasting fare from scratch. Princess dining options include a wide range of culinary delights to suit any palate, from endless buffet choices to gourmet pizza, frosty treats, decadent desserts, and much more.

blocks.heading: Afternoon Tea
blocks.text: Indulge in an elegant spread of freshly made finger sandwiches, delicate cookies, and decadent cakes, served with your choice of fine tea or coffee. Learn more

blocks.heading: Main Dining Room
blocks.text: Our main dining rooms give you the flexibility to choose so you can eat where, when and what you want. Choose from Traditional, Flexible, or Walk-in dining. There’s a menu to please any palate, created by our executive chefs and international culinary team throughout the fleet. Sail with us and savor every dish, from authentic Italian pastas to exclusive family favorites shared by world-renowned c

blocks.heading: Reserve Collection Dining
blocks.text: There’s nothing quite like the Reserve Dining experience. Think private entrance to an exclusive area in the main dining room. Expedited seating and dining on your schedule, no reservations needed. Menu options chosen just for you, including a daily chef’s special. And a dedicated waitstaff to respond to your every request. It’s sure to be your favorite way to dine at sea. Learn more

blocks.heading: International Café
blocks.text: Open 24-hours a day, the International Café located in the Piazza is the place for an ever-changing array of small bite meals, treats and gourmet beverages. Grab a freshly-baked croissant to start your day, snack on pies and quiche or choose from a wide variety of salads and sandwiches at lunchtime, and indulge in decadent deserts in the evening. Coffee and tea fans will love the Lavazza crafted c

blocks.heading: World Fresh Marketplace
blocks.text: Step beyond the traditional cruise buffet and experience a world of flavors.

blocks.heading: Slice Pizzeria
blocks.text: Our top-deck pizzeria features a bold new look that sets the stage for tempting toppings and classic favorites. Try a slice of our award-winning signature Neapolitan-style pizza. Go simple and delicious with just cheese, or mix it up with a variety of toppings that change daily.

blocks.heading: OceanNow® Delivery
blocks.text: In the mood for a drink while soaking up the sun? Want your favorite treat while relaxing at the Piazza? Order with OceanNow® from select locations onboard and have them delivered to you by using the Princess® app. Whether you’re in the Piazza, by the pool, or in your stateroom, we’ll find you. Additional charge may apply.

blocks.heading: The Salty Dog Grill
blocks.text: While you're enjoying the fresh air on the top deck, treat yourself to one of our 100% handmade gourmet burgers, including our Princess Burger or Triple Smoked Burger. Learn more

blocks.heading: Swirls Ice Cream Bar
blocks.text: Ice cream cones and fresh sea air await you at our top-deck creamery. Pick up a chocolate cone, a vanilla, or a combination. Or treat yourself to an ice cream sandwich or a specialty crafted coffee.

blocks.heading: Casual, specialty and culinary experiences
blocks.text: Dining on board a Princess® cruise ship is a joyful celebration and our specialty restaurants always deliver an extraordinary experience. They are among the best at sea – or anywhere. We serve dishes made with the freshest ingredients, and our menus reflect regional flavors from around the world. You'll find our specialty restaurants are the perfect place to celebrate any occasion. Additional char

blocks.heading: A signature steakhouse at sea
blocks.text: Discover premium steakhouse dining at Crown Grill, where carefully aged cuts are prepared to perfection, complemented by a curated selection of gourmet salts and served in a refined, classic steakhouse setting.

blocks.heading: A taste of Italian tradition
blocks.text: Step inside Sabatini’s℠ Italian Trattoria and savor the craftsmanship behind every dish. Using artisanal techniques and fresh, select ingredients, our chefs celebrate the traditions that define true Italian cuisine. Enjoy the journey of flavor—one dish at a time.

blocks.heading: Caymus Winemaker's Dinner
blocks.text: We’re all about the wine. It’s why our onboard dining room received Wine Spectator’s 2023 Award of Excellence. Why we’ve invited iconic Napa Valley wineries – Silverado Vineyards and Caymus Vineyards – on board for chef-designed, multicourse meals. Why we offer 250+ labels and can always recommend the perfect pairing. If you love wine, you're in the right place. Reserve experiences through the Din

blocks.heading: The Catch by Rudi
blocks.text: A first for our ships: this eatery is a seafood bonanza. So many different styles and techniques to showcase the bounty of the sea. Here you can sample everything from the catch of the day to a raw seafood bar. A celebration of all things ocean, from the menu to the setting, from Chef Rudi Sodamin, head of culinary arts. Learn more

blocks.heading: Gigi's Pizzeria by Alfredo
blocks.text: Even if you’re not sailing to Naples (this time), you can still enjoy one of their greatest contributions to the culinary world. Gigi’s Pizzeria serves up certified authentic Neapolitan pizza made to order from scratch in a cheery restaurant named after our very own executive chef and inspired by the colors and landscapes of the Amalfi coast. Learn more

blocks.heading: O'Malley's Irish Pub
blocks.text: Feel like you’ve stepped into a pub in Dublin at this warm, welcoming spot. It goes beyond the music, drinks and food, though you MUST try to the Dubliner Burger. It’s about the feeling you get when you’re here. It’s a bring-the-whole-gang-to-celebrate-a-birthday-or-watch-the-game kind of place. Rich browns and dark greens infuse the pub, named for a famous Irish pirate queen. Learn more

blocks.heading: Gelato
blocks.text: Get a taste of “la dolce vita” at Gelato, our gelateria on board. (Fun fact: gelato isn’t ice cream. While it’s creamy, it has less butter fat and fewer calories.) Our gelato is the real deal, produced fresh each day using the best ingredients and traditional recipes. Choose from a variety of classic flavors which you can enjoy by themselves or in combination with a choice of toppings. Learn more

blocks.heading: 360: An Extraordinary Experience
blocks.text: Embark on an unparalleled adventure through the Mediterranean. This epic, seven-course journey blends storytelling with inspired visuals, rousing music, spectacular cuisine, aromatic scents and immersive technology to transport you to the hilltops of Santorini, the Amalfi Coast, Barcelona and Provence. Cover charge applies. To reserve your extraordinary experience, call the Dine Line or Guest Serv

blocks.heading: Chef's Table Lumiere
blocks.text: An extraordinary treat for both gastronomes and gourmet novices, the Chef’s Table Lumiere is a perfect culinary journey for any special occasion. Indulge in champagne and hors d’oeuvres, followed by an extravagant multi-course dinner created and hosted by the ship’s executive chef. Perfect for celebrating an anniversary or milestone, or just making your cruise vacation even more amazing. Learn mor

blocks.heading: Crab Shack
blocks.text: The Crab Shack is a unique pop-up dining experience with everything from clam chowder and popcorn shrimp to a steamer pot (crab legs, shrimp, clams.). Look for this lunchtime sensation in the World Fresh Marketplace. Learn more

blocks.heading: Ultimate Balcony Dining
blocks.text: A luxurious dining experience at sea all served right on the privacy of your own balcony by our dedicated waitstaff. Treat yourself to this unparalleled indulgence and savor food, views, and memories that will never be forgotten. Learn more

blocks.heading: Activities & Entertainment
blocks.text: Original musicals, dazzling magic shows, feature films, top comedians and nightclubs that get your feet movin’ and groovin’. There’s something happening around every corner; luckily, you have a whole cruise of days and nights to experience it all.

blocks.heading: Princess Live!
blocks.text: By day experience for interactive events and presentations. By night, enjoy stellar entertainment like cabaret acts, comedians, concerts and game shows. There's always something new happening at Princess Live!

blocks.heading: The Piazza
blocks.text: Discover Old World charm as you stroll through our breathtaking Piazza—a hub of activity, inspired by the vibrant squares of Europe. Roving street performers, quaint boutiques, a spiral staircase and several glass-walled lifts provide panoramic views. Visit the International Café for gourmet coffees, grab a pint a O'Malley's Irish Pub, or indulge in authentic gelato.

blocks.heading: Princess Theater
blocks.text: With dazzling stage sets, artists from around the globe, modern hits and timeless classics, the Princess Theater, our largest theater yet, showcases lavish, original productions with dynamic cast members in sumptuous surroundings. In this ultramodern theater, relax in a plush seat with unobstructed sight lines as the velvet curtain goes up, a state-of-the-art lighting system illuminates the stage,

blocks.heading: Vegas Style Casino
blocks.text: From gaming lessons to the latest slot machines to prize tournaments, our Casinos offer fun and excitement. If you enjoy blackjack, or “21,” and Texas Hold 'Em, our tables play by Vegas rules and if you relish the challenge of roulette, we offer the American version.

blocks.heading: Movies Under the Stars®
blocks.text: Throughout the day and night, our exclusive open-air poolside amphitheater is the go-to destination for feature films, thrilling concerts and exciting sporting events such as live football games. Cozy up under a fleece blanket in the comfortable lounger and feast on complimentary fresh-popped popcorn in the evening or delicious cookies and milk during the day, and enjoy that exciting car chase or

blocks.heading: Music & Dancing
blocks.text: When it comes to music and dancing we’ve got everything that your musical palette may desire. Whether it’s tapping your toes to cover bands, singing along in the piano bar, relaxing to classical strings or dancing the night away in Piazza, you’ll be satisfied.

blocks.heading: Pools & hot tubs
blocks.text: Take a dip in our sparkling pools and leave your everyday world behind. Unwind on a padded lounger and soak up the sun, catch up on reading, listen to music or dream of your next adventure on board or ashore. And what better way to relax and revitalize after a day exploring the world than a long soak in one of our whirling hot tubs.

blocks.heading: Top Deck Parties
blocks.text: For breathtaking ocean views and engaging opportunities to meet new friends and celebrate your voyage, no place beats the top deck. Under the sun or under the stars, top-deck parties welcome you to enjoy drinks and dancing, accompanied by a live band. And special themes give each party its own distinctive energy.

blocks.heading: Art Galleries & Auctions
blocks.text: Great art, like the destinations we visit, can be awe-inspiring. Peruse our extensive art gallery, or attend an art history lecture highlighting some of the world’s greatest masters. And don’t miss our exciting Champagne Art Auctions, which give you the chance to view and bid on a wide range of fine art, including pieces by famous artists like Thomas Kinkade, Peter Max, and Michael Godard. There i

blocks.heading: The Shops of Princess
blocks.text: It’s no surprise The Shops are awarded “Best Onboard Shopping” from Porthole magazine year after year. On board, you’ll find a fabulous range of fine merchandise from brands like Swarovski, Chanel, Estée Lauder, Clinique, Lancôme, Calvin Klein, Citizen and Tissot, plus local crafts, keepsakes and souvenirs. And everyday tax- and duty-free savings can add up to as much as 30% off suggested U.S. ret

blocks.heading: Bars
blocks.text: Enjoy great cocktails, craft beer and entertainment late into the night.

blocks.heading: Bellini's
blocks.text: Take in views of the Piazza as you sip a Bellini-inspired specialty cocktail, Champagne, sparkling wine or other fizzy beverage. This stylish bar boasts an Italian flair and a prime location. Perfect for a pre- or post-dinner drink. Learn more

blocks.heading: Good Spirits® at Sea
blocks.text: Good Spirits takes viewers around the globe in search of extraordinary everyday people, sharing stories of spirits and collecting farm-fresh, local ingredients to inspire one-of-a-kind cocktail creations. Immerse yourself in the region as skilled bartenders lead you through an immersive cocktail experience. Learn more

blocks.heading: Crooners
blocks.text: Step into Crooners bar and be transported to the classic Sinatra era, made complete with a top notch pianist singing tunes and tickling the ivories. The “Rat Pack” atmosphere and famous menu of signature martinis, and old-school mixed drinks will have you crooning. Learn more

blocks.heading: Staterooms
blocks.text: From the moment you step aboard, we want you to feel welcomed and right at home. And with attentive service from a friendly staff that knows what hospitality means, you’ll find your Princess® ship truly is your home away from home.

blocks.heading: Wellness
blocks.text: Revitalize and refresh body, mind and soul with Princess®. From rejuvenating spa treatments and the tranquility of a top-deck retreat reserved just for adults to our state-of-the-art fitness centers, you’ll find all the elements for mind & body renewal.

blocks.heading: Kids, Teens & Family
